Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
About the Role
At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and proactive Executive Assistant / Operations Assistant to support leadership and help keep day-to-day business operations running smoothly.
This is a hands-on support role combining executive assistance, administrative coordination, task management, communication, and operational support.
You’ll manage calendars, communications, follow-ups, documents, projects, and recurring operational tasks while helping leadership stay organized and focused on higher-priority initiatives.
This role is ideal for someone who is resourceful, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities with limited supervision.
What You’ll Own
Executive & Calendar Support

- Manage calendars, appointments, and meetings

- Coordinate scheduling across internal and external stakeholders

- Organize meeting logistics and ensure leadership is prepared

- Manage scheduling changes and conflicting priorities

- Coordinate travel and related logistics when required

Inbox, Communication & Follow-Ups

- Support inbox management and email organization when required

- Draft and coordinate professional internal and external communications

- Track important follow-ups and outstanding requests

- Ensure action items do not fall through the cracks

- Escalate urgent or high-priority matters appropriately

Task & Project Coordination

- Track tasks, projects, deadlines, and action items

- Follow up with stakeholders on outstanding deliverables

- Maintain organized trackers for leadership priorities

- Help coordinate administrative and operational projects

- Provide visibility into deadlines, responsibilities, and next steps

Documents, Reports & Presentations

- Prepare and format reports, documents, presentations, and spreadsheets

- Maintain accurate and organized business documentation

- Assist with data entry and administrative reporting

- Organize shared files and information for easy access

- Proofread materials for accuracy and professionalism

Operations & Systems Support

- Support CRM and recurring operational processes

- Maintain accurate information across company systems

- Assist with administrative workflows and process coordination

- Learn and navigate new software, platforms, and AI tools

- Help identify missing information or operational gaps and follow through on resolution

Research & Administrative Support

- Conduct online research as needed

- Compile findings into clear, organized summaries

- Assist leadership with special projects and administrative requests

- Coordinate information across teams and stakeholders

- Support miscellaneous business needs as priorities evolve

Requirements

- 
2+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, Operations Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or similar role

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Strong organizational and time-management skills

- High attention to detail and accuracy

- Strong proficiency with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office

- Experience managing calendars, meetings, documents, and follow-ups

- Comfortable learning new software and AI tools

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously

- Proactive and resourceful problem-solving approach

- Able to work independently with limited supervision

- Reliable internet connection and professional remote-work setup

- Ability to overlap with U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

- Experience directly supporting founders, executives, or senior leadership

- Experience with CRM or project management platforms

- Experience coordinating travel and complex calendars

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Familiarity with tools such as Slack, Zoom, Calendly, Asana, ClickUp, or similar platforms

- Experience using ChatGPT or other AI productivity tools

- Previous experience working with U.S.-based teams

What Makes You a Strong Fit
You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

- Stay organized even when priorities change quickly

- Proactively follow up without needing reminders

- Notice details and inconsistencies others may miss

- Communicate clearly and professionally

- Are comfortable figuring things out independently

- Take ownership of tasks through completion

- Can anticipate leadership needs and prepare accordingly

- Enjoy creating structure in fast-moving environments

What a Typical Day Looks Like
Your day may include reviewing leadership calendars and priorities, coordinating meetings, organizing inboxes, preparing documents, updating trackers, and following up on outstanding action items.
Throughout the day, you may conduct research, update CRM or operational systems, coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, prepare reports or presentations, and support leadership with administrative projects.
In short: you help keep leadership organized, priorities moving, and day-to-day operations running smoothly.
Key Metrics for Success

- Accurate and organized calendar management

- Timely completion of follow-ups and action items

- Strong responsiveness to leadership priorities

- Accurate documents, reports, and operational records

- No missed deadlines or important meetings

- Effective task and project tracking

Our client is looking for an operational partner to a senior executive working across three companies, combining executive assistance with hands-on business support. scraped.title: Assistenz der Geschäftsführung / Founder's Associate (m/w/d) – 100% Remote weltw
scraped.description:
Remote von überall auf der Welt, direkt an der Seite von zwei Gründern, die schon über 20 Firmen aufgebaut haben.
Über uns
Wir bauen Firmen um Menschen herum, die eine gute Idee haben und sie selbst vorantreiben wollen. Unsere beiden Gründer sind Venture-Architekten: Sie bringen Kapital, Vertrieb, Administration und die richtigen Leute zusammen, die Gründer der neuen Firmen bringen Idee und Antrieb. So sind schon über 20 Firmen entstanden, von Pet-Tech über E-Commerce und Einkaufsdienstleistungen bis zu Software für Anwälte. Zusammen beschäftigt die Gruppe weltweit eine dreistellige Zahl an Mitarbeitern.
Unser Ziel ist eine Maschine, die aus jeder guten Idee eine erfolgreiche Firma macht, die ohne die beiden läuft. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die diese Maschine mit aufbaut. Von wo aus du das tust, ist uns egal.
Deine Aufgaben

- Du machst aus unserer Arbeitsweise Prozesse. Vieles steckt heute in den Köpfen der beiden Gründer: wie wir mit Gründern arbeiten, wie wir Firmen aufsetzen, wie Reporting läuft. Du schaust es dir an, schreibst es auf und baust daraus klare Abläufe.

- Du baust ein System, über das die Gründer unserer Firmen regelmäßig berichten.

- Du prüfst neue Ideen am Markt: Du führst viele Kaltakquise-Telefonate, holst ehrliches Feedback ein und hilfst schnell zu entscheiden, ob aus einer Idee eine Firma wird.

- Du managst die Termine der beiden Gründer und buchst Flüge und Reisen.

- Du übernimmst Backoffice-Aufgaben, die auf Deutsch erledigt werden müssen.

- Mit der Zeit wirst du ihre rechte Hand.

Was du mitbringst

- Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gutes Englisch, weil ein Teil unseres Teams in Indien sitzt

- Du denkst in Strukturen und machst gern aus Chaos klare Abläufe

- Mit Fremden zu telefonieren fällt dir leicht, für dich ist es der schnellste Weg zu Antworten

- Du arbeitest selbstständig und brauchst nicht für jeden Schritt eine Anleitung

- Du gehst sicher mit digitalen Werkzeugen und KI-Tools um

- Du bist zuverlässig und diskret, denn du bekommst Einblick in viele Firmen

Erfahrung aus einem Startup, einer Beratung oder als Assistenz der Geschäftsführung hilft, ist aber keine Bedingung. Wichtiger als der Lebenslauf sind uns Lernbereitschaft und Motivation.
Was wir bieten

- 100 % remote, egal wo auf der Welt du lebst

- Festanstellung in Voll- oder Teilzeit, mit Wohnsitz außerhalb Deutschlands ist auch Freelance möglich

- Du lernst extrem schnell: wie Firmen entstehen, finanziert und aufgebaut werden, in über 20 Firmen aus ganz unterschiedlichen Branchen und Phasen

- Du arbeitest direkt mit den beiden Gründern zusammen

- Du baust etwas Eigenes: Die Prozesse und Systeme, die du schaffst, tragen am Ende die ganze Maschine

- Ein klarer Weg nach oben: Wer sich bewährt, wird Chief of Staff und hat Karriereperspektiven bis in die Geschäftsführung oder auf C-Level

Bewerbung
Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte vier kurze Fragen. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.
Fragen vorab beantwortet Felix Wilhelm gern unter +49 176 95422094.

scraped.title: Founder's Associate / Business Operations (m/w/d) – 100% Remote weltweit
scraped.description:
Remote von überall auf der Welt, direkt an der Seite von zwei Gründern, die schon über 20 Firmen aufgebaut haben.
Über uns
Wir bauen Firmen um Menschen herum, die eine gute Idee haben und sie selbst vorantreiben wollen. Unsere beiden Gründer sind Venture-Architekten: Sie bringen Kapital, Vertrieb, Administration und die richtigen Leute zusammen, die Gründer der neuen Firmen bringen Idee und Antrieb. So sind schon über 20 Firmen entstanden, von Pet-Tech über E-Commerce und Einkaufsdienstleistungen bis zu Software für Anwälte. Zusammen beschäftigt die Gruppe weltweit eine dreistellige Zahl an Mitarbeitern.
Unser Ziel ist eine Maschine, die aus jeder guten Idee eine erfolgreiche Firma macht, die ohne die beiden läuft. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die diese Maschine mit aufbaut. Von wo aus du das tust, ist uns egal.
Deine Aufgaben

- Du machst aus unserer Arbeitsweise Prozesse. Vieles steckt heute in den Köpfen der beiden Gründer: wie wir mit Gründern arbeiten, wie wir Firmen aufsetzen, wie Reporting läuft. Du schaust es dir an, schreibst es auf und baust daraus klare Abläufe.

- Du baust ein System, über das die Gründer unserer Firmen regelmäßig berichten.

- Du prüfst neue Ideen am Markt: Du führst viele Kaltakquise-Telefonate, holst ehrliches Feedback ein und hilfst schnell zu entscheiden, ob aus einer Idee eine Firma wird.

- Du managst die Termine der beiden Gründer und buchst Flüge und Reisen.

- Du übernimmst Backoffice-Aufgaben, die auf Deutsch erledigt werden müssen.

- Mit der Zeit wirst du ihre rechte Hand.

Was du mitbringst

- Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gutes Englisch, weil ein Teil unseres Teams in Indien sitzt

- Du denkst in Strukturen und machst gern aus Chaos klare Abläufe

- Mit Fremden zu telefonieren fällt dir leicht, für dich ist es der schnellste Weg zu Antworten

- Du arbeitest selbstständig und brauchst nicht für jeden Schritt eine Anleitung

- Du gehst sicher mit digitalen Werkzeugen und KI-Tools um

- Du bist zuverlässig und diskret, denn du bekommst Einblick in viele Firmen

Erfahrung aus einem Startup, einer Beratung oder als Assistenz der Geschäftsführung hilft, ist aber keine Bedingung. Wichtiger als der Lebenslauf sind uns Lernbereitschaft und Motivation.
Was wir bieten

- 100 % remote, egal wo auf der Welt du lebst

- Festanstellung in Voll- oder Teilzeit, mit Wohnsitz außerhalb Deutschlands ist auch Freelance möglich

- Du lernst extrem schnell: wie Firmen entstehen, finanziert und aufgebaut werden, in über 20 Firmen aus ganz unterschiedlichen Branchen und Phasen

- Du arbeitest direkt mit den beiden Gründern zusammen

- Du baust etwas Eigenes: Die Prozesse und Systeme, die du schaffst, tragen am Ende die ganze Maschine

- Ein klarer Weg nach oben: Wer sich bewährt, wird Chief of Staff und hat Karriereperspektiven bis in die Geschäftsführung oder auf C-Level

Bewerbung
Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte vier kurze Fragen. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.
Fragen vorab beantwortet Felix Wilhelm gern unter +49 176 95422094.

scraped.title: Praktikum CEO Assistenz / Founder's Associate (m/w/d) - 100% Remote - direkt mit
scraped.description:
Mehr als ein Praktikum. Dein Platz neben dem Gründer.
Die meisten Praktika laufen so: Du bekommst einen Platz in einer grossen Abteilung, ein Projekt ohne echte Bedeutung und nach drei Monaten ein Zeugnis, das niemand liest. Hier ist es anders. Du arbeitest 3 bis 6 Monate jeden Tag direkt mit mir, dem Gründer und CEO von TEACHY. Du siehst, wie Entscheidungen entstehen, wie verkauft, verhandelt und geführt wird. Und du gestaltest selbst mit.
Ehrlich gefragt: Was würde in deinem Lebenslauf mehr Türen öffnen? "Praktikant in Abteilung XY" oder "Founder's Associate, direkt dem CEO zugeordnet"?
Ist das für dich?

- Du studierst BWL, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Management oder etwas Ähnliches und suchst ein Pflichtpraktikum oder ein freiwilliges Praktikum

- Du willst später gründen, in die Beratung oder in eine Führungsrolle und suchst die steilste Lernkurve, die du kriegen kannst

- Du willst Verantwortung statt Kaffeeholen und echte Ergebnisse statt Übungsaufgaben

- Du wünschst dir einen Mentor, der dir ehrlich sagt, was schon richtig gut ist und wo du noch wachsen musst

Wenn du bei mindestens drei Punkten nickst, lies weiter. Diese Stelle könnte die wichtigste deines Studiums werden.
Was du nach dem Praktikum kannst

- Verkaufsgespräche führen und Einwände souverän behandeln

- Entscheidungsvorlagen schreiben, die ein Verwaltungsrat ernst nimmt

- Projekte steuern und Dinge wirklich zu Ende bringen

- KI Tools so einsetzen, dass sie dir jede Woche Stunden sparen

- Personal, Finanzen und Marketing aus der Sicht eines Unternehmers verstehen

So sieht deine Woche aus
Jeden Morgen starten wir mit einem kurzen Call: Was sind heute die drei wichtigsten Dinge? Danach arbeitest du selbstständig, bist bei ausgewählten Meetings dabei und wir stimmen uns über den Tag per Chat ab. Am Freitag schauen wir zurück: Was lief gut, was hast du gelernt, was ist nächste Woche dran? Kein Tag ist wie der andere. Du packst dort an, wo du gerade am meisten bewirkst:

- Research und Analysen zu Markt, Wettbewerb, Kund:innen und Partnern

- Koordination von Projekten, Terminen, Pendenzen und Nachfassen

- Sales Support: Leads recherchieren, Angebote vorbereiten, CRM pflegen

- Marketing Support bei Kampagnen, Content und KI Tools

- Support bei Personalthemen wie Rekrutierung, Bewerbungsgesprächen und Onboarding

- Strategie: Du challengst Ideen, Annahmen und Entscheidungen. Auch meine

Wer ich bin
Ich bin Christian von Olnhausen. Vor rund acht Jahren habe ich TEACHY mit nichts gegründet und auf über CHF 7 Mio. kumulierten Umsatz gebracht. Ich habe einen Master in Mathematik der Universität Heidelberg, bin Verwaltungsratspräsident, Speaker, Mitglied im AI Future Council des Swiss Future Institute und bei EO Zürich. Mit TEACHY habe ich sieben Awards gewonnen, darunter den EdTech Award der EPFL.
Ich bin direkt, fordernd und ehrlich. Ich lobe, wenn es verdient ist. Und ich sage dir klar, wenn etwas noch nicht reicht. Dafür teile ich offen, was ich weiss. Und ich erkläre dir, warum ich Entscheidungen so treffe. Wenn du das als Geschenk siehst, wird das eine der wertvollsten Zeiten deines Studiums.
Über TEACHY
TEACHY ist eine der führenden Schweizer Plattformen für Nachhilfe und Lerncoaching. Mit rund 800 Tutor:innen in 55 Fächern helfen wir Kindern, Jugendlichen und Erwachsenen, über sich hinauszuwachsen. Wir sind ein kleines, schnelles Team mit grossen Zielen und einer Mission, die zählt.
Was du mitbringst

- Du bist während des gesamten Praktikums an einer Hochschule oder Universität immatrikuliert. Das ist Pflicht

- Du wohnst in der Schweiz oder in Deutschland

- Du bist hungrig, schnell und zuverlässig. Wenn du etwas zusagst, ist es erledigt

- Du arbeitest strukturiert, denkst mit und stellst auch unbequeme Fragen

- Du kommunizierst klar und sicher auf Deutsch, Englisch ist ein Plus

- Du arbeitest gerne mit digitalen Tools und KI wie ChatGPT, Claude oder Google Workspace

Was du bekommst

- CHF 1'500 pro Monat und damit klar über dem, was die meisten Praktika zahlen

- Tägliches Mentoring direkt vom Gründer statt von irgendwem in der dritten Reihe

- Einblick in das gesamte Business: Sales, Marketing, Finanzen, Personal und Strategie

- 100% remote mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, egal ob aus Zürich, Berlin oder München

- Ein aussagekräftiges Praktikumszeugnis und eine Referenz, die Türen öffnet

Eckdaten
Vergütung: CHF 1'500 pro Monat
Freiwilliges Praktikum: 3 Monate, 100%
Pflichtpraktikum: bis zu 6 Monate, Vollzeit
Arbeitsort: 100% remote aus der Schweiz oder Deutschland
Start: nach Vereinbarung
Bevor du dich bewirbst, frag dich ehrlich

- Wie würde es sich anfühlen, in einem Jahr zurückzublicken und zu merken, dass du diese Chance hast vorbeiziehen lassen?

- Was müsste in diesem Praktikum passieren, damit du am Ende sagst: Das war die beste Entscheidung meines Studiums?

- Was ist dir wichtiger: ein bequemes Praktikum oder eines, das dich verändert?

So bewirbst du dich
Schick mir deinen CV und ein kurzes Anschreiben. Kein Standardtext, sondern du. Beantworte darin drei Fragen: Warum genau diese Rolle und warum jetzt? Was ist das Mutigste, das du bisher gemacht hast? Was willst du in deinen ersten 30 Tagen bewegen?
Der Prozess ist schlank: Bewerbung, Kennenlerncall mit mir, Entscheidung. Bewerbungen ohne individuelles Anschreiben werden abgelehnt. Klingt hart? Ist es auch. Aber es ist fair gegenüber allen, die sich wirklich Mühe geben. Und wenn du bis hierhin gelesen hast, gehörst du wahrscheinlich dazu.

scraped.title: Executive Assistant to the Founder
scraped.description:
Have a background in banking or finance? Ready for a role beyond the usual?
What if your next role combined your financial knowledge, organizational skills, and ability to get things done, working directly with the Founder of a growing Australian business?
Smart Suites is looking for a sharp, resourceful, and highly dependable Executive Assistant to the Founder who can manage more than just calendars and emails.
We're particularly interested in former bankers, finance professionals, and experienced Executive Assistants who understand financial documentation, lending processes, property transactions, and the importance of getting things right.
You'll work directly with our Founder, supporting business and personal priorities, coordinating finance applications, researching asset purchases, and keeping important projects moving.
You don't need to be a financial analyst or property investment expert. We're looking for someone with strong financial awareness, excellent judgement, and the initiative to figure things out. We'll provide guidance and AI-powered tools to support the more technical work. 
What You'll Be Doing

- 
Finance & Banking Coordination: Prepare and organize loan application documents, gather financial records, communicate with banks and brokers, and follow up on lending requirements. 

- 
Property & Asset Purchases: Research potential acquisitions, coordinate due diligence, collect supporting documents, and liaise with agents, lawyers, accountants, and other professionals. 

- 
Financial & Commercial Support: Assist with basic financial comparisons, cash flow summaries, feasibility research, and investment documentation using AI-assisted tools. 

- 
Executive & Personal Assistance: Manage the Founder's calendar, appointments, travel, family-related arrangements, correspondence, and personal commitments. 

- 
Stakeholder Coordination: Communicate professionally with lenders, business partners, suppliers, and internal teams to keep matters progressing. 

- 
Project & Priority Management: Track deadlines, organize information, anticipate requirements, and follow through until tasks are completed. 

What We're Looking For

- At least 2 years of relevant experience in executive assistance, banking, finance, mortgage processing, credit administration, real estate, or a similar professional role. 

- Experience supporting executives, business owners, senior managers, or high-level banking clients. 

- Good understanding of financial documentation, banking processes, lending, or property transactions. 

- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. 

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities. 

- Confidence communicating with banks, brokers, agents, and professional stakeholders. 

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word. 

- Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT to support research, documentation, and productivity. 

- High level of discretion, reliability, and professionalism when handling confidential information. 

- Proactive, resourceful, and capable of working independently without constant supervision. 

You'll Have an Advantage If You Have:

- Previous experience in a bank, financial institution, mortgage brokerage, or lending environment. 

- Experience as an Executive Assistant or Personal Assistant to a Founder, CEO, or senior executive. 

- Familiarity with Australian banking, lending, property, or real estate processes. 

- Experience coordinating finance applications, loan documentation, property purchases, or due diligence. 

- A degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field. 

We value practical experience, sound judgement, and a strong sense of ownership more than job titles or qualifications alone. 
Why This Role Is Different
You're not just managing a calendar. You're helping manage decisions, priorities, and opportunities.
One day, you could be coordinating a finance application with a bank. The next, you might be gathering documents for a property purchase, organizing a family appointment, or following up with advisers on an important transaction.
You'll gain direct exposure to how a Founder manages business operations, financial matters, property opportunities, and personal commitments.
And you won't be expected to do everything manually. Smart Suites uses AI and automation to simplify research, documentation, and administrative workflows, allowing you to focus on coordination, accuracy, and execution. 
About Smart Suites
Smart Suites is a growing Australian hospitality business managing over 100 short-term accommodation rooms across Brisbane, Queensland.
We combine hospitality, technology, and automation to deliver exceptional guest experiences while exploring new opportunities in property acquisition and business expansion.
Our team is guided by six core values: Customer Obsession, Ownership, Curiosity, Humility, Efficiency, and Teamwork (COCHET).
We're looking for someone who shares these values and takes pride in being reliable, adaptable, and effective. 
Engagement Details
Position: Executive Assistant to the Founder (Finance & Property Support) 
Work Arrangement: 100% Remote – Philippines 
Engagement Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor 
Working Hours: Flexible, aligned with the Founder's requirements and Australian business needs 
Business Operating Hours: 5:00 AM–10:00 PM Philippine Time 
Compensation: To be discussed based on experience and qualifications 
Reporting To: Founder

scraped.title: Chief of Staff
scraped.description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
We are looking for a Chief of Staff to help drive BJAK's AI Neobank expansion across products, markets and teams. This is a senior execution role for someone who can align leadership, drive operating cadence, solve cross-functional problems and turn strategy into measurable progress.
What You'll Own

- Drive strategic execution across AI Neobank priorities.  

- Build and manage operating rhythm, OKRs, leadership updates, decision tracking and accountability.  

- Coordinate major workstreams across product, engineering, licensing, market expansion, partnerships, finance and operations.  

- Prepare concise decision memos, board / leadership materials, execution plans and performance reviews.  

- Identify gaps, risks and dependencies before they become serious blockers.  

- Help leadership make sharper trade-offs on people, capital, product and market priorities.  

- Own special projects that require senior judgement and cross-functional authority.

What We're Looking For  

- Strong operator with experience driving strategic execution across teams.  

- Excellent judgement, communication, prioritization and follow-through.  

- Able to work with founders, CEOs, leadership teams and senior external stakeholders.

- Comfortable operating in ambiguity with limited guidance.  

- Can go from high-level strategy to detailed execution without losing quality.  

- Strong writing, business analysis and problem-solving skills.  

- Experience in startups, consulting, strategy, operations, fintech, financial services or regional expansion is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want  

- Makes the company move faster and with more clarity.  

- Can challenge, align and unblock teams without adding bureaucracy.  

- Stays close to facts, numbers, owners and deadlines.  

- Balances strategic judgement with hands-on execution.  

- Low ego, high ownership and strong bias for action.

This Role Is Not For

- People who want a purely advisory role.  

- Candidates who cannot handle pressure, ambiguity or senior accountability.  

- People who create process without improving execution.  

- Those who avoid operational details.  

- People who prefer status over ownership.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in United States. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in United States.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:
1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Technical interview
3. CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Recidiviz is creating safer, healthier communities by improving outcomes for people in the criminal justice system. We build technology to safely reduce the number of people in prison and to help criminal justice leaders embrace data-driven decision-making.
Using software tools and thoughtful product design, we've been able to safely and permanently reduce incarceration and improve outcomes. We work side-by-side with leaders of the criminal justice system, people in prison and on supervision, and ecosystem partners to build a better path forward. In addition to the revenue we earn from state partners, some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations support our work.
People who succeed at Recidiviz lead with kindness and humility, assume good intent, learn from failure, and fix problems when they see them. They are great listeners. They build deep relationships with and empathy for the people we work with and the people our mission serves.
About the role
This isn't a traditional assistant role. You'll own the CEO's calendar, travel and admin with complete reliability. You'll also use your judgment about what the CEO should be doing, who they should be seeing, and what their relationships need, without checking in every time. Our CEO's work spans funders, two boards, and state government relationships that take years to build. You'll quickly learn that network and handle each relationship with care.
Core responsibilities

- 
Manage the calendar with intention, not just scheduling: Own the CEO's calendar across Recidiviz and Edovo. Decide which meetings she should attend and which should be delegated, swapped or pushed, while minding deadlines and stewarding every relationship. Protect deep-work time, and make sure the CEO's time matches each organization's priorities.

- 
Track priorities and support prioritization: Track the CEO's tasks, deadlines and the many requests for their time from development, communications, and state engagement and growth teams. Help them focus on what matters most.

- 
Prepare the CEO for every room: Work with our Development, Communications, Business Development and State Engagement teams to deliver accurate, relationship-aware briefs 24–48 hours before key meetings. Know what makes a great funder brief versus a great brief for a state corrections director, and hold teams to it.

- 
Write as the CEO: Draft and edit the CEO's correspondence, including funder and government correspondence, batch emails such as year-in-review updates and event invitations, and replies in their voice. The bar is light edits.

- 
Triage the CEO's inbound: Be the first line on meeting requests, contact forms and forwarded asks. Decide what the CEO actually needs to see, and make sure nothing sits longer than a day.

- 
Treat travel as strategy: Plan and optimize travel, and propose every trip in advance: who the CEO should see, who's been waiting, what's happening in that city, and which meetings can be stacked.

- 
Close the loop after meetings: Capture what the CEO and others committed to, route takeaways to the right teams, and track commitments to completion, including debriefs from summits and events.

- 
Keep relationships warm: Make sure funders, board members and government partners hear from the CEO at the right cadence. That includes thank-yous after site visits, introductions the CEO promised, renewal milestones, board touchpoints between meetings, and thoughtful no-ask notes.

- 
Keep the company in the loop: Work with the Operations team to run a predictable cadence of internal updates from the CEO.

- 
Make admin invisible: Handle expenses, e-signatures and logistics completely, so they never reach the CEO's attention.

Wild success
Here are a few things you might accomplish in your first year that would demonstrate wild success in this role:

- The CEO's weekly time consistently matches their stated priorities, not whatever is loudest or oldest.

- Every consequential meeting starts with a brief that landed on time and covers relationship history, the meeting's purpose and what a good outcome looks like.

- No important relationship goes cold: every funder, board member and key government partner is touched at the right cadence, through a system you built.

- Every trip is fully stacked, and the CEO's commitments from meetings are captured and closed without them having to track anything.

- You've built new systems for the Office of the CEO, such as a curated weekly briefing on key states, funders and policy news, or a workflow that turns the CEO's voice memos into drafts and action items.

Minimum qualifications

- 
You're exceptionally organized: You bring order to chaos by being thorough and systematic. You love building systems that track many priorities, deadlines and stakeholders at once, and nothing falls through the cracks on your watch.

- 
You have excellent judgment: You weigh competing priorities quickly and make good calls without a playbook. You know when to decide yourself and when to escalate, and you handle sensitive information with discretion.

- 
You're a strong writer: You write clearly and concisely, adapt your tone for funders, government leaders, partners and internal teams, and can learn a specific voice and write convincingly in it.

- 
You're a relationship builder: You're a warm, direct communicator who knows that how something is handled matters as much as what gets done. People want to hear from you, and your warmth never slows things down.

- 
You're proactive and comfortable with ambiguity: You anticipate needs before they come up, fix problems when you find them, and are excited to shape a role across two organizations whose ways of working together are still developing.

- 3+ years of experience in executive operations, executive support, chief of staff, project management, consulting or a similar role.

Preferred qualifications

- 
Experience supporting a senior executive: You've worked closely with a CEO, founder or other senior leader.

- 
Familiarity with philanthropy or government: You've worked with funders, foundations, state agencies or elected officials, and you understand what a strong briefing for those audiences looks like.

- 
A personal connection to the criminal justice system and/or a passion for doing work that matters: You have lived or working experience with the operations and consequences of America's criminal justice system. You don't need to know everything about the field, but the design and efficacy of our criminal justice processes should feel like issues you can't ignore.

Compensation
Compensation is standardized based on roles and responsibilities. This ensures equitable compensation and responsible stewardship of our resources. As such, we do not negotiate compensation offers.
The compensation for this role is $112,000.
What we offer

- Effective, extremely thoughtful colleagues, working together on a mission that matters

- 90% medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage for you and your dependents

- Flexible time off, including 20 days of PTO, 3 days of paid volunteering time, and 13 paid holidays

- 12 weeks of paid parental leave

- 401(k) retirement plan with 5% company match and no vesting period

- Complimentary One Medical membership (depending on location)

- Partnership with Carrot to provide employees with inclusive fertility and family-forming benefits, as well as a small but growing number of hormonal health and gender-affirming care benefits

- Monthly ClassPass credit for personal wellness

- Free mental health support via Talkspace

- Well-located offices in Oakland and Manhattan, with the flexibility to work remotely or go into either office as you choose

- An annual company offsite and other ad-hoc gatherings

An important note
Lasting change is always built on diversity. Recidiviz recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, gender identity and all protected status as required by applicable law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a special need that requires accommodation, please let us know in your application. Even if you don't think you meet all the criteria above, drop your resume, and we'll take a look – you might be great for another role or another time!

100 % remoto | Latinoamérica | Jornada completa
En Human to Human Hub, estamos acompañando a uno de nuestros clientes, una empresa del sector de servicios y negocios digitales, en la búsqueda de un nuevo talento.
¿Tienes experiencia en asistencia virtual y ya utilizas asistentes y agentes de inteligencia artificial para ejecutar tareas, gestionar procesos y obtener resultados reales?
¡Esta oportunidad puede ser para ti! 🚀
Buscamos un/a Asistente Virtual de Operaciones e Inteligencia Artificial con experiencia administrativa, autonomía, organización, orientación al cliente y, especialmente, dominio práctico de herramientas y agentes de IA.
Tu misión será gestionar la operación administrativa y ejecutiva del negocio, coordinar solicitudes, acompañar a clientes y asegurar que los encargos se ejecuten correctamente mediante inteligencia artificial.
Aquí la IA no es una herramienta ocasional: es la forma habitual de trabajar.
No buscamos una persona que únicamente utilice ChatGPT para redactar textos o generar ideas. Necesitamos a alguien que ya sepa dar instrucciones a agentes de IA, activar tareas, supervisar su ejecución, verificar resultados y gestionar seguimientos hasta su resolución.
Si todavía estás aprendiendo a utilizar IA o no has trabajado con ella en procesos operativos reales, esta oportunidad no se ajusta a tu perfil actual.
💻 Requisitos indispensables

- Experiencia mínima de 2 años en asistencia virtual, asistencia ejecutiva, soporte administrativo u operaciones.

- Experiencia práctica y demostrable utilizando asistentes o agentes de IA para ejecutar procesos laborales, no solamente para generar textos, imágenes o ideas.

- Manejo de herramientas como Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini u otras soluciones de inteligencia artificial.

- Capacidad para asignar encargos a agentes de IA, establecer instrucciones claras, supervisar su ejecución, verificar resultados y corregir errores.

- Experiencia gestionando correos, agendas, reuniones, documentación, comunicaciones y seguimientos administrativos.

- Capacidad para organizar múltiples solicitudes y prioridades, trabajando con autonomía y sin depender de instrucciones constantes.

- Excelente comunicación oral y escrita en español.

- Orientación al servicio, empatía y capacidad para ofrecer atención personalizada a clientes.

- Pensamiento crítico, atención al detalle, confidencialidad y responsabilidad sobre los resultados.

- Disponibilidad para trabajar en el horario establecido, coordinando actividades con un equipo ubicado en España.

- Computador propio, conexión estable a internet y espacio adecuado para trabajar de manera remota.

Importante: durante el proceso de selección deberás demostrar cómo utilizas la IA en situaciones operativas reales. No será suficiente mencionar herramientas o presentar conocimientos teóricos.
Valoraremos adicionalmente

- Experiencia en startups, agencias, empresas de servicios o negocios digitales.

- Familiaridad con CRM, Google Workspace, plataformas de formación, marketing digital o herramientas colaborativas.

- Experiencia utilizando flujos de trabajo, instrucciones reutilizables y automatizaciones con IA.

- Conocimientos de inglés escrito.

No necesitas saber programar ni desarrollar integraciones técnicas complejas. Lo indispensable es saber operar, dirigir y supervisar los asistentes y agentes de IA disponibles.
⚙️ Tus principales funciones

- Gestionar mediante asistentes y agentes de IA la agenda, correos electrónicos, reuniones, reservas, comunicaciones y compromisos de dirección.

- Ejecutar tareas administrativas y operativas relacionadas con lanzamientos, campañas, ventas, eventos, mentorías, formación y servicios digitales.

- Asignar encargos a agentes de IA, establecer instrucciones, supervisar avances y comprobar que las tareas se hayan ejecutado correctamente.

- Gestionar búsquedas de proveedores, solicitudes de presupuestos, comunicaciones, seguimientos y coordinación de citas, utilizando las herramientas autorizadas.

- Atender y acompañar a clientes, alumnos y colaboradores mediante IA, manteniendo una comunicación cercana, personalizada y oportuna.

- Gestionar múltiples conversaciones y solicitudes, conservando el contexto y asegurando que ningún compromiso quede sin seguimiento.

- Apoyar la gestión de facturas, presupuestos, documentación y otros procesos administrativos o financieros.

- Mantener actualizados registros, estados de gestión, documentación y compromisos mediante las herramientas digitales disponibles.

- Elaborar y revisar resúmenes, actas, comunicaciones, reportes y documentos con apoyo de IA.

- Detectar errores, verificar información y corregir resultados generados por agentes antes de dar una tarea por finalizada.

- Documentar instrucciones, procedimientos y rutinas reutilizables para mejorar la eficiencia operativa.

- Anticipar necesidades, resolver incidencias dentro de tu ámbito de responsabilidad y escalar únicamente las decisiones que requieran autorización.

El resultado que esperamos: que dirección pueda comunicar qué necesita y tú sepas organizar, activar y supervisar los recursos de IA necesarios para conseguirlo, sin que tenga que perseguir cada tarea.
🎯 Competencias que marcarán la diferencia

- Autonomía y autogestión: asumes responsabilidades y haces seguimiento hasta cerrar los pendientes.

- Pensamiento crítico: no aceptas automáticamente los resultados de la IA; los analizas y verificas.

- Organización y orientación a resultados: sabes priorizar y gestionar varias solicitudes simultáneamente.

- Vocación de servicio: cuidas la experiencia de cada cliente, incluso cuando gestionas múltiples conversaciones.

- Comunicación y transparencia: informas avances, riesgos y errores con claridad y honestidad.

- Curiosidad tecnológica: buscas formas más eficientes de trabajar con las herramientas disponibles.

- Confidencialidad y responsabilidad: proteges la información y actúas dentro de las autorizaciones recibidas.

🌟 ¿Qué ofrecemos?

- Modalidad 100 % remota, desde Latinoamérica.

- Oportunidad de colaborar con una empresa ubicada en España, en un entorno internacional, dinámico e innovador.

- Vinculación freelance mediante acuerdo de prestación de servicios.

- Colaboración de jornada completa, de lunes a viernes.

- Participación en proyectos de formación, comunicación, marketing y negocios digitales.

- Aprendizaje continuo y exposición a herramientas y soluciones de inteligencia artificial.

- Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional según desempeño y necesidades de la empresa.

- Un equipo cercano, colaborativo y orientado a la innovación.

🌍 Ubicación del cliente: España.
🕒 Horario de trabajo: lunes a viernes, de 9:00 a. m. a 6:00 p. m. (hora de España peninsular), con una hora de descanso.
Equivalencia para Colombia:

- Durante el invierno en España: 3:00 a. m. a 12:00 m.

- Durante el verano en España: 2:00 a. m. a 11:00 a. m.

Si resides en otro país de Latinoamérica, deberás ajustar tu disponibilidad al horario de España, teniendo en cuenta los cambios de horario estacionales.
💰 Honorarios: a convenir según experiencia y competencias demostradas.
🚀 ¿Te identificas con este perfil?
Si ya utilizas la inteligencia artificial como parte habitual de tu trabajo, sabes gestionar encargos mediante asistentes y agentes de IA y disfrutas haciendo que las cosas funcionen, queremos conocerte.
Nuestro proceso de selección incluirá una evaluación práctica para comprobar tu experiencia real con IA aplicada a operaciones.
No buscamos únicamente a alguien que conozca herramientas de inteligencia artificial.
Buscamos a alguien que sepa utilizarlas para ejecutar, supervisar y entregar resultados.
¡Postúlate y demuéstranos cómo trabajas con IA!

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

TBIP’s mission is to create a revitalised and resilient information ecosystem in Europe. We are working to tackle the structural power of Big Tech and enable the regulatory and enforcement conditions for policymakers, civil society, and entrepreneurs to develop and scale alternatives to the prevailing model. FOTI is a think tank dedicated to building a prosperous and fair European future that harnesses the power of technology.About the Role

The Senior Executive Assistant & Team Coordinator is a pivotal role providing high-level, proactive support to our Executive Director while acting as a key coordination point across TBIP and FOTI.

Working closely with the Executive Director and Operations & Project Manager, you will take ownership of complex diary and inbox management, coordinate stakeholder and funder engagement, and support effective communication and collaboration across both teams.This is a role for someone who thrives on anticipating needs, exercising sound judgement and navigating competing priorities. You will be a trusted partner to the Executive Director, helping to protect their time, maintain visibility of team activities and ensure that important decisions and commitments are followed through.

You'll be part of a small, highly collaborative and ambitious team working across Europe.

Senior Executive Assistance & Director Support (70%)

Location: Remote; Eastern or Central time zone preferred 
Reports to: Supervisor of Administrative Services

ABOUT OCHIN

OCHIN is a national nonprofit organization headquartered in Portland, Oregon, focused on improving access to quality healthcare, particularly for rural and underserved communities.

Through innovative technology, data insights, and operational support, OCHIN helps its national network of healthcare organizations operate more effectively, strengthen care delivery, improve patient outcomes, and meet the evolving needs of their communities.

THE ROLE

The Executive Partner (EP) serves as a trusted partner to OCHIN's Chief Financial Officer (CFO), combining operational excellence, business acumen, sound judgment, and strategic partnership to increase executive effectiveness and advance organizational priorities.

At the foundation of this partnership is exceptional executive administrative support. The EP will proactively manage the CFO's complex calendar, optimize his time, navigate competing priorities, manage incoming communications, and coordinate travel. This individual will create the structure and organization necessary for the CFO to operate effectively while minimizing demands on his time.

Beyond these core responsibilities, the EP will develop a strong understanding of OCHIN's strategy, priorities, operating context, and member impact, becoming increasingly integrated into the CFO's broader portfolio. This individual will synthesize information, connect stakeholders, and help translate executive priorities into coordinated action and effective follow-through.

ABOUT THE PRINCIPAL

Derek Ross, OCHIN's CFO, oversees a broad portfolio that extends beyond traditional financial operations to include financial business partnership across the organization, technology and IT, revenue consulting services, and organizational improvement initiatives.

Derek is approachable, collaborative, and highly engaged with his teams. He is a thoughtful problem-solver who values relationships and makes himself accessible to others. His broad portfolio and willingness to help often create competing demands on his time.

He works best with someone who takes initiative and brings recommendations. He welcomes candid feedback and thoughtful pushback, values intellectual curiosity, and empowers those around him to work independently. Given the fluid nature of his schedule, he appreciates someone who can adapt as priorities shift without losing sight of what matters most.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Executive Support & Time Optimization

- Proactively manage the CFO's calendar, assess competing priorities, and protect time for focused work, preparation, and reflection.

- Anticipate executive needs, independently advance work, and determine when executive involvement is needed.

- Manage and prioritize the CFO's inbox, coordinate responses, and communicate on his behalf as appropriate.

- Maintain regular check-ins, providing proactive reminders and ensuring follow-through.

- Coordinate frequent domestic travel, prioritizing efficiency and seamless logistics. 

Strategic Partnership & Operational Coordination

- Prepare the CFO for key meetings, stakeholder engagements, and decisions by synthesizing information into relevant insights, recommendations, and executive-ready materials.

- Establish and strengthen operating rhythms, meeting structures, and workflows that improve coordination and accountability.

- Participate in relevant team meetings to deepen understanding of the CFO's portfolio, connect information, and anticipate needs.

- Track executive priorities, decisions, and commitments, identifying emerging issues, risks, dependencies, and opportunities and facilitating resolution or escalation. 

Stakeholder & Team Engagement

- Build trusted relationships across the organization and navigate complex or sensitive situations with discretion.

- Partner with the CFO's direct reports and their teams to strengthen alignment, coordination, and execution across his portfolio.

- 🔥Ambition: building one of the first truly AI-native companies, with teammates who push AI to its limits every week

- 😍Impact: changing the trajectory of a whole company, not one line of a roadmap, with a product that transforms people’s lives at scale

Then, you have found the next adventure that will fulfill you.
WHAT AI-NATIVE MEANS AT PARADOX 🤖
In a company of fewer than 10 people, the right hand used to be the person who absorbed everything the CEO couldn’t do. Here, the right hand builds the machine that does it.
Our company has to be able to:

- Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, offers, decisions, procedures, member stories and past experiments, in one shared company brain that every person and every agent reads before acting.

- Turn every decision into execution. A meeting, a voice note or a call with the CEO becomes briefs, tickets, follow-ups and deadlines, without anyone retyping it.

- Act across every tool. Not a chatbot in a tab: agents read and write in our whole stack, from code to CRM, billing, analytics, ads, email, calendar and documents.

- Ship. Produce the analysis, the contract draft, the page, the offer or the process, and put it live.

- Measure with real KPIs. Revenue, cash, margin, retention and the transformation of our members, not activity.

- Learn and loop on its own. Keep what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

People set the ambition, the taste and the standards. The machine runs the loop, and gets better every week.
This is already real. Our company brain holds our decisions and procedures. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment with its result. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars and audit our tracking after every live. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day, by text and by voice.
But maybe YOU WONDER WHAT’S OUR STORY? 😉
We believe self-help is broken. Most people use learning platforms the same way: generic theory, a quick high, no real change.
They deserve more than content and more than motivation.
They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges and grows with them.
That’s why we merge:

- Human Intelligence (coaches, peers and mentors)

- Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)

- Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

into one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS, the Operating System for Human Greatness, augmented with AI.

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world, and for something that will outlive any individual, its founder included.
Here’s the bet: A small team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size.
And that’s where you come in.
YOUR MISSION 🚀
Reporting directly to the founder and CEO, you will help him run and grow the company.
Your scope is as wide as a CEO/COO’s: strategy, operations, finance, legal, people, product marketing and launches.
The difference is how you do it. In a classic company, the right hand coordinates people and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls. With fewer than 10 people, there is no department to hand things to. You build it.
🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS
1 - Be the CEO’s operating system

- ❌The old way: a chief of staff takes notes in meetings, chases people by email and builds the weekly report by hand.

- 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every CEO decision into execution. Meetings, voice notes and calls become briefs, tickets and follow-ups. Every Monday, the CEO gets one brief: what moved, what’s stuck, and what needs his call.

- You decide what the CEO must see and what he never needs to see again. His time goes to vision, product and members, not to coordination.

2 - Run strategic projects as a Pirate Squad of one, plus agents
Depending on your zone of genius, these are examples of strategic projects you could own:

- Growth: run experiments with agents that generate, ship and measure them

- Partnerships & sponsorships: find and close partners aligned with our brand, for our YouTube channel and events

- International: build the machine that turns our French content into English, and open new countries

- Launches: take a new offer or product from idea to live

- People: find and assess the rare people who join a team of fewer than 10

- ❌The old way: each new initiative needs a team, a roadmap and three months.

- 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: one person with the right agents launches an offer, a channel or a country without disrupting the core. That’s what our Pirate Squad means now.

3 - Build AI-native operations

- ❌The old way: an ops manager processes invoices, chases contracts, onboards people and answers the same support questions every week.

- 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: finance, legal, HR, admin and customer support each get their agents, their context, their KPIs and their loop. You write the skills, plug them into our tools and write the evals that define "good": a reconciliation that matches to the cent, a contract that respects our playbook, an answer a member is happy with.

- You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. An agent moves up a level only when its track record earns it.

- Example: in your first month, you build the agent that reconciles payments, refunds and failed charges every night. In month one it only reports. By month three it fixes the simple cases alone, and you only see the exceptions.

4 - Strategy and business intelligence that check themselves

- ❌The old way: someone builds dashboards in a BI tool, exports them to a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody fully trusts the numbers.

- 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: agents watch revenue, cash, acquisition, retention, churn and competitors continuously, find where our sources disagree, and explain what changed and why.

- Strategy: screen markets and competition, build growth models, explore business models, partnerships and acquisitions. Then challenge, formalize and ensure good execution of the strategy.

- At Paradox things move fast, and our CEO is always reading business books and meeting great entrepreneurs. You’ll turn the best strategies and tactics into systems and agents the whole company uses.

5 - Make the machine better every week, and keep the soul

- ❌The old way: lessons live in people’s heads and leave with them.

- 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: every decision, result and lesson goes back into the company brain, and agents read it before acting. The company never learns the same lesson twice.

- You measure the machine itself: the share of work done without a human, the time from decision to execution, the agents that moved up an autonomy level this month, and revenue per person. You push those numbers up.

- You help the team become AI-native too: you spot the work still done by hand, and you build the agent or show a teammate how to build it.

- And always: our members trust us with their lives. No fake claims, no fake scarcity, data handled with care. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. People do.

How you’ll know you’re AI-native: you spend your time building agents, writing evals and making calls, not doing the work by hand. The company’s output grows every month while the headcount doesn’t.
DO YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF? 😍
Experience

- Top tier Business or Engineering School (HEC, ESSEC, INSEAD, EM Lyon, EDHEC, ESCP, Stanford, …) or other high-level academic training (Les Mines, X, Sciences Po Paris, etc.)

- A wide-scope role behind you: founder, chief of staff, founder’s associate, strategy, consulting or operations in a fast-growing startup

- You’ve built with AI and agents yourself: Claude Code, agent SDKs, MCP, automations, APIs, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

Traits

- Driven with strong work ethic: this position requires a strong commitment and perseverance

- Entrepreneurship spirit: able to own a project from scratch, with few resources and little guidance, doing a lot yourself

- Builder, not coordinator: you’d rather build the agent than chase a person twice

- Taste: you know the difference between an output that works and one that is great, and you hold agents to the second

- Growth over ego: you are at ease with regular feedback, obsessed with learning and growing, able to put your ego aside

- Analytical and system thinker: you quickly identify and formulate problems, and solve complex ones with data

- Excels in communication: both written and verbal

Language
French: native or bilingual. English: fluent, you can hold a detailed conversation with English-speaking colleagues. Our chosen language for written communication is English.
IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

- We are inspired by a culture of performance and ambition. Everything is fast-paced and there is a lot of change. You won’t always be told what to do or how to do it.

- We tell each other things, even if they are uncomfortable. We value growth over ego. At Paradox, expressing disagreement to a manager and knowing how to debate is valued! We encourage critical and strategic thinking.

- ❌ If you use AI for first drafts but your way of working looks the same as two years ago: wrong role.

- ❌ If you want to manage a lot of people: we aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each managing a dozen agents.

- ❌ If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.

If all this makes sense with you, then we’ll love working with you (and you with us, you’ll be pampered!)
WHY JOIN US ❤️
Build one of the first truly AI-native companies from inside the CEO’s office, and write the playbook others will copy. You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.
A work with Impact, Freedom and Ambition
Growth & Ambition 🚀

- 🏅Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform, whilst being in a good mood

- 🏋️‍♀️No more bosses, but ongoing conversations to support your growth

- ⚡️Learning to build with AI faster than almost anywhere else

Impact & Meaning 🔥

- 🦄Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products are used by millions of people

- 🤩Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something! We receive messages every day from members who quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships and changed their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…
Freedom & Well Being 🗽☀️

- 😎A company culture based on autonomy & accountability

- 🗽Flexible working hours (but very hard working)

- 🌎A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want

- 🧍‍♀️Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices

- 💻Work on Mac

- 🏀350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, a dance class or whatever makes you feel great)

- 📚150€ of books or education: at Paradox, we are learner lovers

- 🔥Access to Athena, our AI coach, supporting you on anything personal or professional

HOW TO APPLY 📃
❌ Any copy-pasted and non-personalized application goes directly to the trash can.
⚠️ To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this: do not apply ⚠️
Hiring process

- 📃 A 6 to 8 minute application survey, with a short video and a link to something you built with AI

- 💻 A 30-minute video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions

- 🛠️ A live build session: you solve a real Paradox problem with AI in front of us. We look at how you prompt, push back on the output and iterate, more than at a polished result.

- 💻 A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset

- 💻 A 1h final video call with David, CEO, on the company’s next milestones and how you’d build them

- 💼 Reference calls with your previous managers

- 🤗 Welcome aboard!

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us 🚀🚀

This role is highly focused on keeping the lead pipeline organized and moving. You’ll communicate with prospective customers, schedule appointments for the sales representative, maintain accurate CRM records, and help ensure leadership has a clear view of pipeline performance.
What You’ll Own
Lead Intake & Management

- Receive and accurately log incoming leads.

- Ensure every new inquiry is captured in the CRM promptly and without gaps.

- Maintain complete and accurate lead records.

Lead Outreach & Scheduling

- Call prospective customers to understand and qualify their needs.

- Answer initial questions and introduce the company professionally.

- Book appointments for the sales representative to visit customers and present estimates.

CRM Workflow Management

- Move leads through each stage of the pipeline consistently.

- Keep lead statuses current and accurate.

- Maintain CRM data so the team can track set rate, close rate, and other key metrics in real time.

Customer Communication

- Serve as a professional and knowledgeable first point of contact.

- Answer customer questions and set appropriate expectations.

- Represent the company positively on every call.

Reporting Support

- Keep records clean, organized, and up to date.

- Support leadership in pulling accurate pipeline data.

- Help identify where leads are converting or falling off.

Process Adherence

- Learn and consistently follow the company's established workflow.

- Identify and flag bottlenecks in the process.

- Help maintain consistency across daily operations.

Required Experience & Skills

- At least 1–2 years of experience in an administrative, customer-facing, or operations support role.

- Familiarity with CRM software and managing contacts, deal stages, and records.

- Experience in painting, residential or commercial construction, or another home service trade is a strong plus.

- Clear and confident spoken English.

- Comfortable communicating with homeowners and prospective customers by phone.

- Strong organizational habits and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple active leads simultaneously.

- Ability to learn new workflows quickly and apply them consistently without close supervision.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

- You take ownership of your pipeline and proactively follow up when leads go cold.

- You communicate proactively when something is unclear or a process breaks down.

- You are comfortable on the phone and can adapt your communication style to different customers.

- You bring structure to a busy day and can prioritize a full call list effectively.

- You keep CRM records organized and consistently up to date.

What Success Looks Like

- Every incoming lead is captured accurately and promptly.

Executive Assistant
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
About the Role
We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and trustworthy Executive Assistant to provide dedicated support to two senior executives.
This is more than a traditional administrative role. You will take full ownership of executive inboxes, calendars, communications, and day-to-day coordination, ensuring leadership can focus on strategic priorities while you keep operations running smoothly behind the scenes.
The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator with exceptional organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage highly confidential information with complete discretion. Success in this role requires someone who is responsive, independent, and comfortable representing leadership when interacting with clients, vendors, and internal teams.
Responsibilities
Executive Inbox & Communication Management

- Manage and organize executive email inboxes using Microsoft Outlook. 

- Prioritize incoming emails, flag urgent matters, and draft professional responses on behalf of leadership. 

- Ensure timely follow-up on important communications. 

- Serve as the communication bridge between executives, clients, vendors, and internal teams. 

- Handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion. 

Calendar & Meeting Management

- Own executive calendars across multiple time zones. 

- Schedule, reschedule, and coordinate meetings while preventing scheduling conflicts. 

- Organize Zoom and Microsoft Teams meetings, including invitations and meeting logistics. 

- Protect executive time by prioritizing meetings and managing scheduling efficiently. 

Phone-Based Executive Support

- Remain available and responsive by phone throughout U.S. Central business hours. 

- Receive instructions and delegated tasks directly from leadership via phone. 

- Accurately capture notes and convert verbal instructions into actionable tasks. 

- Execute assigned work promptly and provide updates upon completion. 

Administrative Coordination

- Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements. 

- Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, reports, and supporting documentation. 

- Take meeting notes and track follow-up action items. 

- Maintain organized digital files, records, and documentation. 

- Assist with research and special projects as needed. 

- Coordinate vendor communications and administrative workflows. 

Client & Stakeholder Support

- Communicate professionally with clients, vendors, and external partners via email, phone, and video calls. 

- Act as the primary point of contact on behalf of leadership when appropriate. 

- Build positive relationships while maintaining a high level of professionalism. 

CRM & Operational Support

- Maintain and update records in Salesforce CRM. 

- Track projects, deadlines, and executive priorities. 

- Monitor outstanding action items and follow up to ensure timely completion. 

- Help leadership stay organized by maintaining visibility across ongoing initiatives. 

What Makes You a Strong Fit

- You take ownership without needing constant supervision. 

- You communicate professionally and confidently with executives and clients. 

- You excel at managing multiple priorities without missing deadlines. 

- You are highly organized and thrive in fast-paced environments. 

- You handle confidential information with integrity and discretion. 

- You enjoy solving problems and anticipating executive needs before they arise. 

Required Experience & Skills
Must-Have

- 3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or similar executive support role. 

- Proven experience managing executive calendars and high-volume email inboxes. 

- Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills. 

- Strong organizational and multitasking abilities. 

- Ability to manage confidential information with complete professionalism. 

- Fast and accurate typing skills for documenting phone-based instructions. 

- Experience coordinating meetings across multiple time zones. 

- Comfortable communicating directly with clients and external stakeholders. 

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment. 

- Availability during U.S. Central Time business hours (9:00 AM–5:00 PM CST). 

- Reliable internet connection and professional home office setup. 

Technical Skills

- Microsoft Outlook 

- Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) 

- Microsoft Teams 

- Zoom 

- Salesforce CRM 

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?
Your day begins by reviewing executive inboxes, prioritizing urgent emails, and preparing calendars for the day ahead. Throughout the day, you coordinate meetings, respond to communications, manage scheduling changes, and execute tasks delegated by leadership over the phone.
You prepare documents, organize travel arrangements, update Salesforce, communicate with clients and vendors, and ensure every commitment is tracked and completed on time.
By the end of the day, leadership has clear calendars, organized communications, completed follow-ups, and confidence that every important task is moving forward.

- Client Interview

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. It’s a short, self-recorded video, completed once on your own time, and it’s the final step that completes your application.

scraped.description:
The Cigna Group is looking for a highly organized and proactive Senior Executive Assistant to join our Enterprise Clinical organization. This role will provide administrative support for the Chief Medical Officer (CMO) of The Cigna Group, acting as a trusted resource and professional problem solver. In addition to foundational administrative tasks, this role will be responsible for running point on cross-team initiatives to support senior leaders and ad-hoc requests. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter with exceptional communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, exhibiting a high degree of discretion, confidentiality, and sound judgment. 

Responsibilities:

- Perform diversified and confidential administrative duties for the CMO as assigned, utilizing broad and comprehensive experience, skills, and knowledge of organizational policies and practices.

- Execute on complex scheduling requests that will include varying leadership levels across the enterprise, including the Enterprise Leadership team as well as various senior leadership forums. Act with speed, accuracy, and efficiency to complete requests.

- Coordinate and project manage visits to Cigna offices for C-suite leaders. Project management tasks include: Planning the visit agenda, working with local teams on logistics, facilitating technology and food & beverage needs, partnering with travel and meeting services, sending out invites, etc.

- Own the calendar for the CMO and ensure an efficient and feasible schedule, prioritizing as needed to manage the leader’s time effectively in a schedule and environment of competing demands. Make last-minute calendaring decisions based on priority and business needs using sound judgment.

- Build effective relationships and work closely with internal partners to perform key tasks. This includes peer administrative and executive assistants, executive IT support, corporate internal communications, corporate travel/aviation, etc.

- Act as administrative lead for department meetings; includes scheduling, logistics, and technology needs.

- Handle travel arrangements for leaders and prepare and settle expense accounts. Ensure that all plans are managed seamlessly and coordinate related arrangements. 

- Anticipate problems and needs before they happen and proactively work to resolve and/or address them.

- Schedule and organize meetings, including Webex and conference calls to be hosted by the CMO and/or direct reports (i.e., booking training rooms, posting materials to SharePoint, sending pre-reads to participants) as required.

- Plan and coordinate onboarding activities as needed for new leadership and team members.

- Maintain and coordinate department distribution lists and SharePoint/file systems.

- Order equipment and supplies using the portal supply system.

- Manage department space planning in conjunction with the office Real Estate team.

- Manage department vendor payment activities, track and approve invoices, and assume delegate responsibilities for travel and expense entries for the leader using Concur. 

Qualifications: 

- 8+ years of progressively responsible administrative or executive assistant experience required. 

- Can work independently with minimal direction, exhibit sound judgment, and maintain confidential information. 

- Impeccable organizational skills with the ability to work in a very high-paced environment and manage multiple tasks.

- Previous project management experience is required.

- Ability to ruthlessly prioritize critical tasks and remain composed and focused in stressful situations, utilizing customer-centricity skills.

- Act with speed and decisiveness. Ability to sum up a situation, gather the necessary information, ask the right questions, and then deliver/act. 

- Expert-level verbal and written communication skills. 

- Experience managing calendars, including setting up smaller to larger meetings with multiple cross-enterprise teams. Outlook preferred. Experience using meeting platforms.

- Demonstrate flexibility to not only support the direct leader, but also other team members as required.

- Ability to work in a virtual workforce and team environment. Build effective networks and relationships to best support leader and perform the role.

- Expert skills in Microsoft applications - Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Excel with a willingness to learn advanced skills as appropriate. 

- Ability to troubleshoot technology issues in partnership with Technology partners.

- Possess technical proficiencies with audio and voice equipment as well as mobile and desktop devices.
