scraped.description:
Ophthalmology Patient Services Coordinator
(Front + Back End Support)

Remote | Ophthalmology | Part-Time | 30 Hours per Week | Schedule: U.S. Eastern Time | Exact Schedule to Be Confirmed
About the Role
We are seeking a highly professional, articulate, and dependable Virtual Medical Assistant (VMA) to support the daily front desk, patient coordination, and administrative operations of a U.S.-based ophthalmology practice.
The ideal candidate has strong medical front desk experience, exceptional English communication skills, and preferably direct experience supporting an ophthalmology or eye care practice.
This is primarily a patient-facing administrative role focused on managing phone calls, coordinating appointments, maintaining accurate patient records, and ensuring timely follow-through on patient requests. The position also involves insurance benefits verification when requested and occasional payment follow-up responsibilities.
You will work closely with the physician and in-office team to deliver an exceptional patient experience while helping maintain efficient, organized, and reliable clinic operations.
Key Responsibilities
1. Front Desk Operations, Patient Communication & Scheduling

- Answer inbound calls professionally, confidently, and courteously, serving as a primary point of contact for patients.

- Manage voicemail messages, return missed calls promptly, and conduct outbound patient follow-ups.

- Schedule, reschedule, and cancel patient appointments accurately using the practice management system.

- Coordinate new and established patient appointments following ophthalmology scheduling and triage protocols.

- Handle general patient inquiries, appointment reminders, and administrative concerns.

- Gather and verify patient demographics, create new patient charts, and maintain accurate electronic medical records.

- Escalate clinical questions, urgent concerns, and complex scheduling requests to the appropriate clinical staff.

2. Patient Coordination, Referrals & Administrative Support

- Receive, process, and organize patient referrals using designated electronic systems.

- Coordinate referred patient scheduling and ensure necessary documentation is accurately maintained.

- Document patient requests, create follow-up tasks, and route messages to the physician or appropriate clinical team members.

- Monitor outstanding tasks and follow through to ensure patient concerns and administrative requests are addressed.

- Coordinate closely with in-office staff regarding patient appointments, messages, and pending requests.

- Maintain organized patient records and provide daily accomplishment or status updates as required.

- Follow established clinic workflows, HIPAA requirements, and patient confidentiality protocols.

3. Insurance Benefits Verification & Payment Follow-Up

- Verify insurance eligibility, coverage, benefits, and deductible information when requested.

- Utilize insurance portals to obtain accurate and current patient benefits information.

- Communicate verification findings clearly to the clinic to support accurate patient financial discussions.

- Conduct professional outbound calls regarding overdue patient balances when assigned.

- Document insurance verification activities and payment-related communications accurately.

Insurance verification and payment follow-up are supporting responsibilities. The primary focus of this role remains patient communication, front desk operations, and appointment coordination.
Required Qualifications

- Proven experience supporting a U.S. healthcare practice in medical front desk operations, patient scheduling, or administrative support.

- Outstanding English verbal and written communication skills, clear pronunciation, professional phone etiquette, and strong executive presence.

- Hands-on experience managing inbound and outbound patient calls, voicemail follow-ups, and appointment coordination.

- Proficiency in navigating electronic medical record (EMR/EHR) systems and maintaining accurate patient information.

- Working knowledge of insurance eligibility and benefits verification, with the ability to conduct accurate checks when requested.

- Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple responsibilities efficiently.

- Strong critical thinking, sound judgment, and ability to recognize situations requiring escalation to clinical personnel.

- Demonstrated reliability, accountability, initiative, and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Professional, patient-centered communication skills and commitment to delivering excellent service.

Strongly Preferred Qualifications
Direct experience supporting an ophthalmology or eye care practice is strongly preferred and will be prioritized during candidate evaluation.
Additional advantages include:

- Familiarity with ophthalmology appointment types, patient intake, referrals, and scheduling workflows.

- Experience coordinating with ophthalmologists, ophthalmic technicians, and in-office clinical teams.

- Hands-on experience using Nextech / Practice Plus.

- Familiarity with Reach UC, Microsoft Teams, Availity, and other insurance portals.

Systems & Technology
The practice utilizes healthcare and communication platforms such as:

- Nextech / Practice Plus: Patient records, appointment scheduling, and administrative task management.

- Reach UC: Patient calls, voicemail management, and messaging.

- Microsoft Teams: Internal team coordination.

- Insurance Portals: Availity and other payer platforms for requested benefits verification.

- Time Doctor: Work activity and productivity tracking.

Candidates should be technologically proficient and comfortable learning new systems and following established workflows.
What We're Looking For
We are looking for a dependable healthcare professional who understands that exceptional front desk support goes beyond answering calls and scheduling appointments.
The ideal candidate communicates confidently, treats patients with courtesy and empathy, takes ownership of assigned responsibilities, and consistently ensures that important patient requests are handled accurately and on time.
If you have strong medical front desk experience, outstanding communication skills, and a background in ophthalmology, we encourage you to apply.

En Human to Human Hub, estamos acompañando a uno de nuestros clientes, una empresa del sector de servicios y negocios digitales, en la búsqueda de un nuevo talento.
¿Tienes experiencia en asistencia virtual y ya utilizas asistentes y agentes de inteligencia artificial para ejecutar tareas, gestionar procesos y obtener resultados reales?
¡Esta oportunidad puede ser para ti! 🚀
Buscamos un/a Asistente Virtual de Operaciones e Inteligencia Artificial con experiencia administrativa, autonomía, organización, orientación al cliente y, especialmente, dominio práctico de herramientas y agentes de IA.
Tu misión será gestionar la operación administrativa y ejecutiva del negocio, coordinar solicitudes, acompañar a clientes y asegurar que los encargos se ejecuten correctamente mediante inteligencia artificial.
Aquí la IA no es una herramienta ocasional: es la forma habitual de trabajar.
No buscamos una persona que únicamente utilice ChatGPT para redactar textos o generar ideas. Necesitamos a alguien que ya sepa dar instrucciones a agentes de IA, activar tareas, supervisar su ejecución, verificar resultados y gestionar seguimientos hasta su resolución.
Si todavía estás aprendiendo a utilizar IA o no has trabajado con ella en procesos operativos reales, esta oportunidad no se ajusta a tu perfil actual.
💻 Requisitos indispensables

- Experiencia mínima de 2 años en asistencia virtual, asistencia ejecutiva, soporte administrativo u operaciones.

- Experiencia práctica y demostrable utilizando asistentes o agentes de IA para ejecutar procesos laborales, no solamente para generar textos, imágenes o ideas.

- Manejo de herramientas como Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini u otras soluciones de inteligencia artificial.

- Capacidad para asignar encargos a agentes de IA, establecer instrucciones claras, supervisar su ejecución, verificar resultados y corregir errores.

- Experiencia gestionando correos, agendas, reuniones, documentación, comunicaciones y seguimientos administrativos.

- Capacidad para organizar múltiples solicitudes y prioridades, trabajando con autonomía y sin depender de instrucciones constantes.

- Excelente comunicación oral y escrita en español.

- Orientación al servicio, empatía y capacidad para ofrecer atención personalizada a clientes.

- Pensamiento crítico, atención al detalle, confidencialidad y responsabilidad sobre los resultados.

- Disponibilidad para trabajar en el horario establecido, coordinando actividades con un equipo ubicado en España.

- Computador propio, conexión estable a internet y espacio adecuado para trabajar de manera remota.

Importante: durante el proceso de selección deberás demostrar cómo utilizas la IA en situaciones operativas reales. No será suficiente mencionar herramientas o presentar conocimientos teóricos.
Valoraremos adicionalmente

- Experiencia en startups, agencias, empresas de servicios o negocios digitales.

- Familiaridad con CRM, Google Workspace, plataformas de formación, marketing digital o herramientas colaborativas.

- Experiencia utilizando flujos de trabajo, instrucciones reutilizables y automatizaciones con IA.

- Conocimientos de inglés escrito.

No necesitas saber programar ni desarrollar integraciones técnicas complejas. Lo indispensable es saber operar, dirigir y supervisar los asistentes y agentes de IA disponibles.
⚙️ Tus principales funciones

- Gestionar mediante asistentes y agentes de IA la agenda, correos electrónicos, reuniones, reservas, comunicaciones y compromisos de dirección.

- Ejecutar tareas administrativas y operativas relacionadas con lanzamientos, campañas, ventas, eventos, mentorías, formación y servicios digitales.

- Asignar encargos a agentes de IA, establecer instrucciones, supervisar avances y comprobar que las tareas se hayan ejecutado correctamente.

- Gestionar búsquedas de proveedores, solicitudes de presupuestos, comunicaciones, seguimientos y coordinación de citas, utilizando las herramientas autorizadas.

- Atender y acompañar a clientes, alumnos y colaboradores mediante IA, manteniendo una comunicación cercana, personalizada y oportuna.

- Gestionar múltiples conversaciones y solicitudes, conservando el contexto y asegurando que ningún compromiso quede sin seguimiento.

- Apoyar la gestión de facturas, presupuestos, documentación y otros procesos administrativos o financieros.

- Mantener actualizados registros, estados de gestión, documentación y compromisos mediante las herramientas digitales disponibles.

- Elaborar y revisar resúmenes, actas, comunicaciones, reportes y documentos con apoyo de IA.

- Detectar errores, verificar información y corregir resultados generados por agentes antes de dar una tarea por finalizada.

- Documentar instrucciones, procedimientos y rutinas reutilizables para mejorar la eficiencia operativa.

- Anticipar necesidades, resolver incidencias dentro de tu ámbito de responsabilidad y escalar únicamente las decisiones que requieran autorización.

El resultado que esperamos: que dirección pueda comunicar qué necesita y tú sepas organizar, activar y supervisar los recursos de IA necesarios para conseguirlo, sin que tenga que perseguir cada tarea.
🎯 Competencias que marcarán la diferencia

- Autonomía y autogestión: asumes responsabilidades y haces seguimiento hasta cerrar los pendientes.

- Pensamiento crítico: no aceptas automáticamente los resultados de la IA; los analizas y verificas.

- Organización y orientación a resultados: sabes priorizar y gestionar varias solicitudes simultáneamente.

- Vocación de servicio: cuidas la experiencia de cada cliente, incluso cuando gestionas múltiples conversaciones.

- Comunicación y transparencia: informas avances, riesgos y errores con claridad y honestidad.

- Curiosidad tecnológica: buscas formas más eficientes de trabajar con las herramientas disponibles.

- Confidencialidad y responsabilidad: proteges la información y actúas dentro de las autorizaciones recibidas.

🌟 ¿Qué ofrecemos?

- Modalidad 100 % remota, desde Latinoamérica.

- Oportunidad de colaborar con una empresa ubicada en España, en un entorno internacional, dinámico e innovador.

- Vinculación freelance mediante acuerdo de prestación de servicios.

- Colaboración de jornada completa, de lunes a viernes.

- Participación en proyectos de formación, comunicación, marketing y negocios digitales.

- Aprendizaje continuo y exposición a herramientas y soluciones de inteligencia artificial.

- Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional según desempeño y necesidades de la empresa.

- Un equipo cercano, colaborativo y orientado a la innovación.

🌍 Ubicación del cliente: España.
🕒 Horario de trabajo: lunes a viernes, de 9:00 a. m. a 6:00 p. m. (hora de España peninsular), con una hora de descanso.
Equivalencia para Colombia:

- Durante el invierno en España: 3:00 a. m. a 12:00 m.

- Durante el verano en España: 2:00 a. m. a 11:00 a. m.

Si resides en otro país de Latinoamérica, deberás ajustar tu disponibilidad al horario de España, teniendo en cuenta los cambios de horario estacionales.
💰 Honorarios: a convenir según experiencia y competencias demostradas.
🚀 ¿Te identificas con este perfil?
Si ya utilizas la inteligencia artificial como parte habitual de tu trabajo, sabes gestionar encargos mediante asistentes y agentes de IA y disfrutas haciendo que las cosas funcionen, queremos conocerte.
Nuestro proceso de selección incluirá una evaluación práctica para comprobar tu experiencia real con IA aplicada a operaciones.
No buscamos únicamente a alguien que conozca herramientas de inteligencia artificial.
Buscamos a alguien que sepa utilizarlas para ejecutar, supervisar y entregar resultados.
¡Postúlate y demuéstranos cómo trabajas con IA!

scraped.title: Senior Administrative Assistant – Executive Support
scraped.description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

In This Role
You will provide proactive administrative and operational support to leaders within a global technology organization focused on commercial partner initiatives. You will manage executive calendars, meetings, travel, expenses, and stakeholder communications while helping the broader team stay organized and aligned. This role requires someone who understands business priorities, anticipates needs, and acts as a trusted partner rather than providing only transactional administrative support.
Responsibilities

- Manage complex executive calendars, competing priorities, meeting requests, and scheduling changes.

- Coordinate domestic and international travel, including itineraries, airport logistics, executive preferences, and last-minute adjustments.

- Prepare, submit, and reconcile travel expenses while ensuring accuracy and compliance.

- Organize internal meetings, leadership discussions, team engagements, and local partner activities.

- Prepare agendas, reports, presentations, memos, correspondence, and other business documents.

- Support communication and coordination across leaders, internal teams, external partners, and extended stakeholder groups.

- Review incoming communications and materials, determine their significance, and coordinate appropriate follow-up or distribution.

- Anticipate administrative and operational needs, identify potential conflicts, and proactively drive solutions.

- Track deadlines, action items, commitments, and stakeholder requests to ensure timely completion.

- Maintain organized and confidential records, reports, and corporate documents.

- Support general office operations, including supplies, invoicing, records management, and basic bookkeeping activities.

- Build strong working relationships and serve as a dependable partner to supported leaders and the broader administrative team.

- Ensure all assigned activities are completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with organizational policies.

Qualifications

- High school diploma or GED.

- 5–7 years of executive administrative, business support, or related professional experience.

- Demonstrated experience supporting executives and understanding their priorities, preferences, and business needs.

- Extensive experience coordinating complex domestic and international travel.

- Strong experience preparing, managing, and reconciling executive expense reports.

- Proven ability to manage complex calendars, meetings, scheduling conflicts, and changing priorities.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, or comparable productivity tools.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Excellent organizational, time-management, customer-service, and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and take initiative.

- Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

- Ability to meet deadlines and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced, stakeholder-driven environment.

- Willingness and ability to work the required schedule consistently, as working hours are not flexible for time-zone differences.

- Stable employment history without a recurring pattern of short-term positions.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting leaders within a commercial business or technology organization.

- Experience working in a global, cross-functional environment across multiple regions or time zones.

- Experience supporting partner-facing, healthcare-related, go-to-market, sales, or operational initiatives.

- Demonstrated ability to anticipate executive needs and proactively resolve issues before they affect schedules or deliverables.

- Ability to understand broader business objectives and connect administrative activities to team priorities.

- Experience coordinating across small, midsized, and corporate external partners.

- Strong stakeholder-management skills and the confidence to ask clarifying questions when additional business context is needed.

- Experience improving administrative processes, workflows, or established ways of working.

- Ability to provide basic mentoring, support, or constructive feedback to colleagues.

Compensation
At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market.
For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated compensation range is $30 to $38 per hr. Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final compensation and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications.

Benefits

Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

- Medical, dental, and vision coverage

- Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

- 401(k) retirement plan

- Competitive paid time off

- Parental leave

- Professional growth and development opportunities

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Blueprint Technologies, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicant Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please contact .

scraped.description:
About the Job:
LaunchDarkly is seeking an Executive Assistant to partner closely with our Chief Revenue Officer and support the broader global Revenue organization as it scales.
This role will help the CRO stay focused on the highest-priority work by managing their calendar, travel, meetings, and competing priorities. The right person will anticipate needs, resolve scheduling conflicts, and make thoughtful decisions about what requires the CRO’s attention.
The Revenue organization spans Sales, Customer Success, pre- and post-sales, Partnerships, and international markets. As the organization grows, the EA may also provide administrative support to other senior Revenue leaders. The right person will be comfortable working across time zones, navigating senior stakeholders, handling confidential information, and learning the CRO’s priorities and working style.
LaunchDarkly is a rapidly growing software company with a strong mission and vision carried out by a talented and diverse team of employees. Our goal is to help teams build better software, faster. Software powers the world and LaunchDarkly empowers all teams to deliver and control their software.
Responsibilities:

- Manage the CRO’s calendar, priorities, meeting flow, and time allocation across a globally distributed organization.

- Triage scheduling requests and prepare the CRO for key meetings by confirming logistics, participants, and materials; recommend what should be delegated, deferred, or declined.

- Manage domestic and international travel, bookings, logistics, expenses, approvals, and last-minute changes.

- Plan and coordinate Revenue leadership offsites, including quarterly gatherings, and other executive events; attend select events in person.

- Coordinate scheduling and logistics for the CRO’s participation in Revenue leadership meetings and other recurring forums in partnership with the Chief of Staff and Revenue Operations.

- Provide administrative support to the global Partnerships leader and, as the organization grows, other senior Revenue leaders.

- Coordinate meetings with customers, partners, executives, and other strategic stakeholders.

- Build strong relationships across Revenue, Finance, People, Legal, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams while maintaining systems that improve visibility and follow-through.

- Handle sensitive information with discretion and confidentiality and support administrative follow-through for select executive priorities and events.

Qualifications:

- Experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Business Partner, or comparable role supporting senior or C-level executives in a globally distributed organization.

- Experience working in a software or technology company; high-growth or B2B SaaS experience is a plus.

- Experience managing executive calendars, travel, expenses, complex scheduling, and meeting or event logistics.

- Demonstrated ability to anticipate problems, protect executive focus, and make sound decisions about competing priorities.

- Strong organization, attention to detail, follow-through, written and verbal communication, and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to learn an executive’s working style and business priorities, manage up, and support multiple senior leaders as needs evolve.

- Sound judgment, discretion, emotional intelligence, and comfort handling confidential information.

- Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and related collaboration tools.

- AI fluency and curiosity, with the ability to use emerging tools thoughtfully to improve productivity, organization, and administrative workflows while protecting confidential information.

- Experience supporting a CRO, President, CEO, or other externally facing executive is a plus.

Pay:
Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 4:

- Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $136,000 - $187,000**

- Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $122,000 - $168,000**

- Zone 3: All other US locations - $116,000 - $159,000**

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.
*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.
About LaunchDarkly:
Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations. 
The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

- Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages

- Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts

- Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize

- Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types

- Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We provide these services to federal, provincial, regional, local and Indigenous governments, to the forestry, energy, mines, petroleum, transportation and utility sectors, and to numerous regional invasive species organizations across Canada.

SRG is a business unit of an employee-owned company formed in 2017, known as Wright Canada Holdings (WCH). scraped.title: Administrative Assistant
scraped.description:
Company Overview

Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables.

Job Summary
Kairos Power is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Administrative Assistant to join our team in Albuquerque, NM, or Oak Ridge, TN. The ideal candidate will demonstrate the ability to effectively manage multiple tasks, ranging from routine administrative duties to more complex responsibilities. We are looking for someone who is exceptionally organized, detail-oriented, personable, and adaptable. The successful candidate will exhibit patience, professionalism, and the ability to consistently produce high-quality work under tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Responsibilities

- Provide comprehensive administrative support to the Government Affairs and Marketing and Communications teams, including calendar management, coordinating internal and external meetings, preparing briefing materials, booking travel, and other administrative tasks. (60% Government Affairs / 40% MarCom)

- Government Affairs-Specific Responsibilities:

- Support the preparation and submission of state and federal lobbying activity reports and other required government affairs filings; maintain accurate records of lobbying activities, expenditures, registrations, and reporting deadlines. 

- Assist with preparing briefing materials, talking points, background information, presentations, contact lists, and other materials for Government Affairs engagement. 

- MarCom-Specific Responsibilities:

- Support the public relations team by maintaining a detailed schedule of external events, tracking speakers, sponsorships, and budget.

- Assist with ordering and shipping materials for Kairos Power-sponsored events

Under the general supervision of the Operations Manager, the Lead Disability Assistant is responsible for the coordination of administrative processing of disability determinations for all in and out of state contracts. The Lead Disability Assistant is responsible for work flow management and training of Disability Assistants as well as performing those front line functions when necessary to maintain unit production standards. To learn more about our companies and how we spark a lifelong love of reading, please visit our website at 

Job Purpose

Books Are Fun is looking for a detail-oriented, enthusiastic Junior Customer Success Manager (Jr. CSM/Admin) to join our mission-driven team. In this client-facing, support-focused role, you will assist our Customer Success team in delivering exceptional experience to schools participating in our Book Blast program, while reporting to a Senior Customer Success Manager. This role is perfect for someone who is organized, loves working with people, and wants to grow in a customer success or account management career.

The ideal candidate is passionate about customer experience, anticipates client needs, and consistently delivers remarkable service experience. As Books Are Fun continues to grow, we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with it. You’ll have the opportunity to deepen your expertise, take on greater ownership within your role, and contribute to shaping our customer success function as it scales.

- Support Customer Success Managers by helping schools throughout their Book Blast journey, from onboarding to event completion.

- Assist with follow-ups, scheduling, and routine client communications to ensure schools feel supported and informed. This includes both phone call and email follow-up.

- Maintain accurate and detailed records of client accounts, communications, and outcomes.

- Help gather client feedback, testimonials, and referrals to support program growth.

- Assist with coordination of events, materials, and schedules for Book Blast launches. This includes ordering materials weekly in preparation for launches.

- Assist with light research or preparation for client meetings.

Event Management

- Serve as the primary point of contact for schools during peak weeks and throughout the season as needed.

- Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with school leaders through personalized outreach and proactive problem-solving.

- Implement retention strategies based on Never Lose a Customer Again principles to maximize renewals and engagement.

- Identify and escalate at-risk accounts to the Senior Customer Success Manager to ensure timely intervention.

Training & Development

- Participate in ongoing training and coaching to deepen knowledge of customer success best practices, sales techniques, and program details.

- Encourage and gather testimonials, referrals, and client advocacy to grow the Books Are Fun network.

- Leverage client satisfaction to build a network of advocates for Books Are Fun.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Friendly, professional, and proactive attitude.

- Comfortable supporting multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

- Passion for books, education, and creating positive experiences for clients.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

- Comfortable learning and using CRM software to track client interactions and account records.

- Comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day work, and eager to learn new ways to use them.

This is a high-ownership, high-trust role that exists to create meaningful leverage for the CEO by managing complexity, protecting their focus, and ensuring the company's operating rhythm runs without friction.

Qualifications
Required

- Experience managing high-volume, high-stakes calendars and travel logistics across multiple time zones

- Exceptional organizational skills — a proven system for managing complexity and ensuring nothing slips

- Impeccable judgment and discretion with sensitive, confidential information across all areas of a business

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft on behalf of an executive in their voice

- High ownership orientation — sees what needs to happen and makes it happen without waiting to be told

scraped.title: Migration Admin Assistant— Visa Applications & Case Management

This is a remote position.
Migration Admin Assistant — Visa Applications & Case Management (Outlook, Excel, Migration Manager, Xero)
Remote | Philippines | Full-Time | Php 40,000/month, with a performance-based rate review after six months | 6:30 AM – 3:30 PM PHT, Mon–Fri (8:30 AM – 5:30 PM AEST) | Long-Term Remote Role 
If you’re a high-performing admin or legal support professional who is detail-obsessed, speaks up with confidence, and is eager to learn a new industry on the job — and you want to work with a well-established Australian migration agency that values strategic impact over simple task completion — keep reading. 
This isn’t a role for a “quiet task-taker” who waits to be told what to do next. 
This is a focused, outcome-driven position where you’ll take the administrative load off a team of Registered Migration Agents, so every visa application is lodged complete, accurate and on time. 
Why This Is a Dream Job
You’ll be working directly with the migration team of an established Australian immigration agency who: 

- 
Trains You Properly: Teaches its systems and visa workflows through hands-on, collaborative training alongside experienced migration agents and case managers. You don’t need prior immigration experience. 

- 
Values Your Growth: Gives you a dedicated Success Manager (CSM), monthly scorecards and quarterly reviews, plus a planned rate review at six months based on your performance. 

- 
Respects Your Voice: Wants you to share your thinking, raise risks early and suggest better ways of working, including practical uses of AI tools. 

- 
Builds Stability: Offers a long-term, ongoing role (not project-based), with room to grow as the team scales, including helping onboard future teammates. 

- 
Gives You Daily Support Early On: Holds daily touchpoints with the Operations Leader in your first weeks before moving to a weekly check-in. 

You’ll get career transformation, real exposure to the Australian immigration field, and the chance to grow from guided support to trusted case owner, without being stuck doing data entry with no path forward. 
What You’ll Be Owning
This is a core operations support role covering application preparation, case management and client communication. You aren’t just filing documents; you’re the person who knows where every assigned case stands, catches gaps before an agent does, and keeps clients informed, while leaving all immigration advice and decisions to the authorised agents. 
You’ll take the lead on: 

- 
Application Package Preparation: Preparing and pre-checking visa application packages in Migration Manager against the agent’s checklist, so every package is complete and ready for agent review before the internal deadline. 

- 
Case Control: Updating every case in Migration Manager and Microsoft Planner after each action, and making sure no case stalls without a logged next step. 

- 
Deadline & Visa Expiry Tracking: Owning visa expiry reminders and lodgement deadlines across your caseload, with zero misses. 

- 
Document & Payment Follow-ups: Chasing outstanding documents, information and payments without prompting, and keeping invoicing and service agreements current in Xero. 

- 
Inbox & Client Communication: Managing the shared inbox and calls, answering client, agency and embassy emails on time, actioning urgent requests the same day, and escalating advice-related questions to the supervising agent. 

- 
Drafting & Research: Drafting routine correspondence and supporting statements under agent supervision, and researching legislation and policy updates as directed. 

- 
Process Improvement: Finding and implementing better templates, checklists, AI-assisted drafting and workflow changes that cut repetitive manual work for the team. 

Requirements
This Role Is a Great Fit If You:

- 
Have Admin or Legal Support Experience: You’ve worked in paralegal, legal support or administrative support roles. This is an entry-level role suited to someone ready to be trained. 

- 
Already Know Outlook and Excel: You use both confidently from day one without basic training. Migration Manager, Planner and Xero will be taught. 

- 
Catch What Others Miss: You spot gaps and errors in documents and treat 100% accuracy as the standard, not a stretch goal. 

- 
Juggle Deadlines Calmly: You keep many cases moving at once and prioritise without losing track. 

- 
Speak Up and Take Initiative: You ask questions early, share your progress, and act without being asked. 

- 
Know the Line: You understand that administration and immigration advice are different, and you escalate anything advice-related to the supervising agent. 

- 
Handle Information with Discretion: You treat sensitive client details with strict confidentiality. 

- 
Are High-Accountability: You don’t need to be chased for updates. You’re reliable, meet deadlines, and own your mistakes as much as your wins. 

- 
Communicate with Confidence: You write and speak clear, professional English with clients, agencies, embassies and the team. 

- 
Can Commit to the Schedule: You’re comfortable working remotely on Australian business hours, Monday to Friday. 

Genuine differentiators (not requirements): Exposure to immigration law or Australian Department of Home Affairs processes; Xero or Migration Manager experience; using AI tools in everyday work. 
What Success Looks Like
After 60–90 Days:

- 
Training Signed Off: You’ve completed on-the-job training in Migration Manager, Planner, Xero and core visa workflows, and work independently on routine tasks. 

- 
Cases Keep Moving: Every assigned case is current in Migration Manager and Planner, follow-ups are tracked, and no case stalls without a next step. 

- 
Deadlines Are Never Missed: Visa expiry reminders and deadlines go out on schedule, and risks are flagged before they become urgent. 

- 
Clients Are Well Informed: The inbox is answered on time, urgent requests are handled the same day, and advice questions reach the right agent. 

- 
Trust Is Earned: You’ve proposed at least one concrete process improvement, and the agents rely on you to run routine case work with light supervision. 

Final Word
If you’ve ever thought: 
“I’m organised, detail-focused and ready to grow. I just want a team that will train me properly, listen to my ideas and give me real ownership.” This is that role. 
Let’s build long-term success — together.

scraped.title: Bookkeeper & Finance Admin - Malaysia
scraped.location: Remote (Brunei Darussalam, Cambodia, Indonesia, Lao People's Democratic Republic, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Timor-Leste, Vietnam)
scraped.description:
About the role
Comms8 is looking for a hands-on Bookkeeper & Finance Admin to take ownership of our day-to-day bookkeeping and finance administration across our group.
This is a practical, detail-focused role for someone who is comfortable keeping financial records accurate and up to date, reconciling accounts, processing invoices and expenses, and preparing regular finance reports.
You will support four entities across two jurisdictions and work closely with our team and accountants in the UK and Hong Kong.
Importantly, our UK and Hong Kong accountants handle all statutory filings and audit requirements. You will provide accurate records and information to support them, but you will not be responsible for owning statutory compliance or audit.
The role will initially focus entirely on finance. Once the month-end process is running accurately and consistently, the role will gradually expand to include general administrative support.
What you'll be doing
Finance & Bookkeeping

- Manage day-to-day bookkeeping across four group entities

- Complete regular bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable

- Prepare and issue client invoices and follow up on outstanding payments

- Process and record business expenses

- Prepare payroll data for UK employees and offshore contractors

- Record and reconcile intercompany transactions between business entities

- Produce a standard monthly finance pack

- Prepare a weekly cash and aged-debtors report using an established template

- Maintain accurate and well-organised financial records

- Respond to queries and provide supporting information to our UK and Hong Kong accountants

- Support month-end processes and help ensure the books are complete, accurate and ready for accountant review

You will not be expected to handle statutory filings or audits as these will be managed by our UK and Hong Kong accountants, giving you the opportunity to focus on maintaining accurate books and running the day-to-day finance processes well.
Admin Support
Once you have established a reliable month-end routine, the role will expand to include:

- Contractor onboarding and offboarding paperwork

- Vendor, subscription and business-tool administration

- Document filing and record-keeping across the four entities

- General administrative support for the operations team

What we're looking for

- 2–5 years of experience in bookkeeping, finance administration or a similar hands-on finance role

- Solid experience with day-to-day bookkeeping and bank reconciliations

- Experience handling accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoicing and expenses

- Good understanding of month-end bookkeeping processes

- Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

- Organised and consistent in maintaining records and following established processes

- Confident communicating with colleagues and accountants

- Good written and spoken English

- Comfortable working across multiple entities and currencies

- Able to work the required hours with regular overlap with our UK and Hong Kong teams

Experience preparing payroll data, handling intercompany transactions or working with international/remote businesses would be an advantage.
Working arrangement
This is a full-time contractor engagement, not an employment position.
The role is fully remote and open to candidates based across Southeast Asia.
Because you will work closely with colleagues and accountants across the UK and Hong Kong, availability during the required working hours and sufficient overlap with both teams is a mandatory requirement for this role.
Compensation
USD 500–800 per month, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated bookkeeping capability.
What success looks like
In your first few months, the priority will be straightforward: accurate books, clean reconciliations and a dependable month-end process.
Once the finance routine is running smoothly, you will begin supporting selected administrative tasks across the business.
If you are a practical, organised bookkeeper who enjoys keeping financial records accurate and processes running consistently, we'd be pleased to hear from you.

scraped.title: Lead LA Supervisor, Oversight of LA Supervisors
scraped.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is a nationally scaling personal injury firm that owns the client experience end to end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We've grown 2-3x year over year for three years running, and we're now building the operations, systems, and teams to scale without sacrificing quality or culture. We're fully remote, and we value ownership, open communication, and speed. If you want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel at home here.

The Opportunity

The Lead Supervisor leads the Claims Verification (CV) Department at Topdog Law and oversees all CV Supervisors, who in turn lead the Claims Verification Specialists and Legal Assistants (LAs) on their state teams. The role owns the quality, speed, and consistency of how claims are verified, how clients are contacted, and how claims are handed off to the legal team across every state Topdog Law serves.

The Lead Supervisor builds the department's processes, trains and develops its leaders, and holds the team accountable to clear standards for client communication, insurance coverage analysis, turndown documentation, and case handoffs. This is a hands-on leadership role with a warm, team-first approach: Supervisors are coached, supported, and held accountable so their teams do the same.

What You Will Own

Leading and Developing Supervisors

- Hold regular one-on-ones and end-of-week (EOW) check-ins with Supervisors and Leads, giving feedback on wins, challenges, and metrics.

- Build a close, cooperative relationship with the state-specific CV Supervisors and Leads, and support them in every aspect, from work metrics to conflicts with teammates, with ongoing monitoring and guidance.

- Coach Supervisors to coach their own teams, and help with difficult issues, escalations, and personnel conversations.

- Coach Supervisors on creating an out-of-compliance game plan for their teams, and follow up to make sure the plan is carried out and brought to completion.

- Identify and develop future leaders, including recommending and evaluating candidates for promotion to Lead and Supervisor.

- Set clear expectations for accountability, and hold Supervisors to them consistently.

State Team Oversight

- Oversee the day-to-day performance of each state team so claims move through Claims Verification on time, including new claims, claims in the Turn Down phase, and personal caseloads.

- Make sure clients are contacted promptly and that contact cadence is kept, since consistent client communication is a core standard.

- Make sure new claims are triaged on time and that tasks and claims are assigned and routed to the right person, including CAT and Commercial claims.

- Support the move to a State Integrated model, so Specialists and Legal Assistants know where their accountability starts and stops and where it hands off to Case Managers.

- Understand and prepare lists of the state-specific nuances that are not consistent across the firm, and keep a working knowledge of them.

Quality, Compliance, and Audits

- Audit work for quality and compliance, such as turndown documentation, Q and A, handoffs, and expense and invoice entry for third-party research (such as Red Folder results), and correct issues that appear across states.

- Coordinate projects across the department and follow up as needed on auditing, so findings are corrected and closed out.

- Run reports on statutes of limitations (SOL) so no claim is at risk of expiring, and follow up with the owner of any claim that is approaching its SOL.

- Review police reports, insurance coverage, and policy questions as an escalation resource for the team.

- Make sure handoffs to Case Managers and Attorneys are complete, accurate, and consistent.

Process, Training, and Communication

- Build, document, and maintain department SOPs, checklists, and training materials, such as duplicate file handling, reassigning previously terminated claims, and handoff checklists.

- Lead trainings and workshops, and prepare the team for new tools, systems, and process changes, including rollouts and integrations.

- Send regular team communications, such as weekly announcements, recognition, and reminders, to keep the team motivated, informed, and aligned.

- Use dashboards and reports to track performance, and review the numbers with Supervisors and Leadership.

- Brainstorm on an ongoing basis with Supervisors and Leadership to find time-saving improvements, and put them into effect across the department.

Cross-Team Partnership

- Partner with Case Managers, Attorneys, Intake, Learning and Development, and peer managers to resolve issues, escalate when needed, and keep handoffs smooth.

- Implement surveys across the CV Department, its Leaders, and the other departments that work hand in hand with LA and CV, to make sure the team understands the changes and feels heard, and act on the feedback.

- Report team performance, risks, and results to the Director and Leadership, and share information from Leadership back to the team.

What You Bring

Required:

- Extensive legal operations experience, ideally 10 or more years, with a track record of building departments, implementing procedures, and leading teams.

- Previous experience managing managers or supervisors, ideally in a multi-state personal injury environment.

- Strong working knowledge of insurance coverage, claims, and the personal injury intake and case handoff process.

- Experience with case management software (such as Filevine), dashboards, and reporting.

- Experience designing and delivering training, SOPs, and process documentation.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Core Competencies

- 
Leadership and coaching: Warm, team-first leadership that invests in developing others while holding them accountable.

- 
Accountability: Sets clear standards and follows through, with an emphasis on consistency and cadence.

- 
Process thinking: Builds clear, repeatable systems and documents them.

- 
Communication: Keeps a large, multi-state team informed, motivated, and aligned.

- 
Problem solving: Handles escalations, difficult conversations, and cross-team issues with good judgment.

- 
Data literacy: Uses dashboards and metrics to spot trends and guide coaching.

- 
Adaptability: Leads the team through change, such as new tools, integrations, and structure changes.

How Success Is Measured

- State and department performance against the Claims Verification goals shown on the department dashboards, such as turndown rate, verified cases, and time to process.

- Timely handling of new claims and Turn Down claims, with few claims out of compliance or over SLA.

- Consistent client contact cadence across all teams.

- Quality of handoffs and documentation, based on audits and feedback from Case Managers and Attorneys.

- Growth, retention, and engagement of Supervisors, Leads, and Specialists, including promotion readiness.

- Successful rollout of new processes, tools, and training across states.

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

- 
Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"

- 
Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.

- 
No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.

- 
Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.

- 
Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

- Base Salary: $80,000 - $90,000, commensurate with experience

- Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.

- Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or being a qualified disabled veteran or qualified veteran of the Vietnam era or any other category protected by Federal or State law.

DISCLAIMER: This is a full-time employee position. It is not open to independent contractor or consulting arrangements. Compensation is determined by the location where the work is performed and is subject to applicable local law.

These tools assess job-related qualifications and characteristics—such as work experience, education, and skills relevant to the position as described in the job posting—based on information you provide in your application materials (e.g., resume, application responses, and other submitted materials, if any).

All adverse decisions affecting your candidacy are reviewed by a human member of our Talent Acquisition team before being finalized. AI does not make the final decision on your candidacy.

This is a high-trust role supporting senior leadership, with responsibilities expected to include calendar and travel management, coordination with internal and external stakeholders, meeting preparation and follow-up, research, communications, and broader executive support in a fast-paced, high-profile environment.

The ideal candidate is proactive, highly organized, resourceful, and capable of working with minimal supervision. You should be someone who can identify what needs to be done, determine the best way to accomplish it, and follow through without needing constant direction.
Estimated Salary: The salary for this position has not been finalized yet. Please indicate your expected salary based on your experience in the application form, and we will consider it in our discussions.
Responsibilities:
Executive Support

- Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support to senior executives.

- Manage complex calendars, schedules, appointments, and competing priorities.

- Coordinate meetings, calls, and virtual appointments across multiple time zones, including Zoom meetings.

- Help executives start each day organized and prepared by reviewing the calendar, highlighting key meetings, and proactively flagging new people, companies, or priorities that may require additional preparation.

- Conduct advanced research on new contacts, companies, meeting participants, and relevant preferences or background information to help executives prepare effectively.

- Prepare meeting agendas, briefing materials, presentations, and other executive documents.

- Manage executive correspondence, communications, and follow-ups through email, iMessage, and other communication channels as needed.

Proactive Administrative & Operational Support

- Anticipate executives' needs and proactively address issues before they become problems.

- Own administrative processes and projects from initiation through completion.

- Research information, gather options, make recommendations, and present findings clearly.

- Conduct basic company and background research to support meetings, decision-making, and executive preparation.

- Coordinate with internal teams, clients, vendors, and external stakeholders.

- Follow up on outstanding tasks and ensure deadlines are met.

- Develop and maintain systems, trackers, SOPs, and organizational processes that improve efficiency.

Travel & Logistics

- Assist with meeting, event, and off-site logistics.

- Handle last-minute changes and troubleshoot logistical issues as they arise.

- Coordinate travel and logistics approximately 2–3 times per month, with the flexibility to accommodate changing needs.

Communication & Coordination

- Draft and proofread professional emails, documents, presentations, and other correspondence.

- Communicate professionally with executives, clients, partners, vendors, and other stakeholders.

- Represent executives professionally when coordinating schedules, meetings, and requests.

- Manage sensitive information and maintain a high level of discretion and confidentiality.

- Use strong written and verbal communication skills to ensure information is communicated clearly and efficiently.

General Executive & Administrative Support

- Assist with special projects and executive-level initiatives.

- Conduct online research and prepare summaries, reports, or recommendations.

- Maintain organized digital files, records, and documentation.

- Support expense management, including receipt collection, tracking, and reconciliation through Ramp or similar expense-management software.

- Support basic reporting and administrative coordination where required.

- Take on other responsibilities that support the effectiveness and productivity of the executive team.

Requirements

- 3+ years of experience in executive assistance, virtual assistance, administrative support, operations coordination, or a similar role.

- Previous experience supporting executives, founders, business owners, directors, or senior leaders is strongly preferred.

- Proven experience working as a Virtual Assistant, Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Executive Administrative Assistant, or similar high-level administrative professional.

- Strong experience managing calendars, schedules, meetings, correspondence, and executive priorities.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities without becoming overwhelmed.

- Strong judgment and the ability to determine what requires immediate attention versus what can wait.

- Highly proactive and resourceful; able to work independently without needing step-by-step instructions.

- Comfortable researching unfamiliar topics , companies, and individuals and figuring out solutions independently.

- Strong follow-through and accountability—you don't need to be repeatedly reminded to complete tasks.

- High level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information.

- Strong proficiency with common productivity and collaboration tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Zoom, Slack, iMessage, project management platforms, and similar tools.

- Comfortable working with international teams and across different time zones.

- Comfortable coordinating domestic and international travel and adapting to changing priorities throughout the day.

The Ideal Candidate
You will thrive in this role if you:

- Think ahead rather than simply react to requests.

- Can take a broad instruction and turn it into a completed outcome.

- Are comfortable saying, "I've already taken care of it."

- Naturally keep track of details, deadlines, and follow-ups.

- Can manage several executives' priorities without losing sight of the bigger picture.

- Are resourceful and know how to find answers rather than waiting for someone else to provide them.

- Have strong business judgment and know when to act independently and when to escalate.

- Can distinguish between a true priority and something that can reasonably wait.

- Are comfortable making judgment calls when an executive is unavailable and know when something is important enough to interrupt or follow up.

- Are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and changing priorities.

- Take ownership of your work and treat the executive's time as highly valuable.

- Are dependable, discreet, polished, and professional in all interactions.

- Naturally prepare ahead of meetings by understanding who the executive is meeting, why the meeting matters, and what background may be useful.

Qualifications That Are a Plus

- Experience supporting C-suite executives, founders, entrepreneurs, or senior leadership.

- Experience working with international clients or companies.

- Experience supporting executives based in the US or other international markets.

- Experience managing multiple executives or stakeholders simultaneously.

- Experience with project management or operations coordination.

- Familiarity with tools such as Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, Notion, Airtable, HubSpot, Ramp, or similar platforms.

- Experience creating SOPs, workflows, systems, and process documentation.

- Experience coordinating travel, events, or complex business logistics.

- Experience with presentation preparation and PowerPoint formatting/editing.

What Success Looks Like

- Within the first few months, a successful Executive Administrative Assistant should be able to:

- Become a reliable extension of the executive they support.

- Start each day with a clear understanding of the executive's schedule, priorities, and upcoming needs.

- Manage recurring administrative responsibilities with minimal supervision.

- Keep calendars, meetings, communications, travel, and follow-ups organized.

- Proactively research new people, companies, and meetings so the executive is prepared in advance.

- Anticipate upcoming needs and proactively prepare for them.

- Take ownership of projects and administrative processes rather than simply completing individual tasks.

- Make sound judgment calls about priorities and know when to act independently versus when to escalate.

- Resolve routine issues without unnecessary executive involvement.

- Reduce the executive's administrative workload and allow them to focus more time on strategic priorities.

- Build trust through consistency, discretion, sound judgment, responsiveness, and strong follow-through.

Paired is a global recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent. We help individuals from around the world connect with great companies that are looking for their specific skill set. Our mission is to provide great jobs to talented people, no matter where they are located.
About Our Clients
Our client is the founder of a Dubai-based agency operating in a fast-paced international environment. The founder moves fast, communicates directly, and has very high standards. The right person for this role genuinely enjoys operating in high-responsibility environments and takes pride in making chaos look effortless.
This role is for someone who is naturally proactive, highly organized under pressure, emotionally steady, and extremely responsive. You will be managing personal logistics, travel, scheduling, household coordination, and lifestyle operations with minimal oversight.

- Coordinate personal travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, transportation, restaurant reservations, and itineraries

- Manage personal scheduling including medical appointments, fitness sessions, grooming, and other lifestyle commitments

- Handle visa renewals, residency documentation, licenses, and other personal administrative requirements proactively

- Coordinate household-related operations including vendors, maintenance, deliveries, installations, repairs, and property-related communication

- Manage personal errands, sourcing requests, returns, exchanges, and gift procurement

- Communicate with external stakeholders including accountants, lawyers, building management, concierge services, and vendors

- Handle time-sensitive and last-minute logistical requests efficiently

- Maintain accurate calendar management across different time zones

- Anticipate problems before they arise and execute solutions independently

- Ensure a high level of confidentiality, professionalism, and discretion at all times

High-Level Execution

- Proactively identify and resolve challenges before they arise

- Work autonomously and make confident, well-informed decisions swiftly

- Communicate with clarity, precision, and professionalism

- Uphold the highest standards of discretion and confidentiality consistently

- Remain composed and effective in high-pressure situations

- Exude natural assertiveness with a calm and measured approach

- Bring extensive experience working remotely over multiple years

- Possess in-depth knowledge of the hospitality, luxury, and travel industries

- Efficiently coordinate and manage international vendors independently

Requirements

- At least 2 years of experience supporting a founder, executive, entrepreneur, or C-level professional

- Availability across Dubai and European time zones required

- Strong experience working remotely across multiple time zones

- Polished, presentable and professional appearance

- Socially sophisticated, boasting high emotional intelligence

- Proven track record in affluent and high-achieving settings

- Must be highly responsive, detail-oriented, and reliable

- Excellent spoken and written English with strong communication skills

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

- Highly proactive, resourceful, and capable of operating independently without constant supervision

- Comfortable working in a high-responsibility environment with changing schedules and urgent requests

- Strong internet research and problem-solving skills

- Able to maintain professionalism and composure under pressure

- Experience coordinating international travel and lifestyle logistics is highly preferred

- Candidates with only junior VA or entry-level administrative experience may not be considered

- Junior VAs looking for training

- Candidates who prefer highly structured corporate environments

- Competitive salary.

- Work with fast-scaling, premium brands

- 
Workplace: Remote

- 
Schedule: Monday-Friday schedule, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM PST. or 9:00 AM-6:00 PM PST

About Us
HireHawk connects experienced professionals with U.S. companies building high-performing remote teams. For this opportunity, you will support a U.S.-based legal practice handling Personal Injury civil litigation, working closely with attorneys while taking meaningful ownership of day-to-day litigation support.
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced bilingual English-Spanish Civil Litigation Paralegal with hands-on California Personal Injury litigation experience. You will take substantial ownership of written discovery, communicate directly with Spanish-speaking clients, prepare litigation documents, and help attorneys keep cases moving toward deadlines.
This is role is for someone who already understands how California civil litigation works in practice. You should be comfortable handling routine litigation matters independently, identifying what information is missing, following up proactively, and knowing when an issue requires attorney review.
The team values practical PI litigation knowledge, reliability, and work ethic more than having a minimal accent. Strong bilingual communication and the ability to get accurate information from clients matter most.
Responsibilities

- Own the preparation, organization, and coordination of written discovery for California Personal Injury litigation matters.

- Prepare and support responses to interrogatories, requests for production, requests for admission, and related discovery requests.

- Communicate directly with English- and Spanish-speaking clients to gather case facts, records, documents, and other information required for discovery.

- Review client responses and supporting documents, identify missing or incomplete information, and follow up until discovery packages are ready for attorney review.

- Draft and prepare pleadings and other routine civil litigation documents with limited supervision.

- Coordinate with attorneys to ensure discovery responses, pleadings, and supporting materials are complete, accurate, and submitted on time.

- Track California litigation deadlines, discovery due dates, court dates, and other case-related milestones.

- Prepare and coordinate California Superior Court filings and electronic filings.

- Organize medical records, supporting documents, client materials, and litigation files so attorneys can quickly access the information they need.

- Assist with motions and other litigation documentation when required while recognizing when attorney input or approval is necessary.

Requirements

Must-Have:

- Significant hands-on experience supporting U.S. Personal Injury civil litigation matters, including practical California litigation experience.

- Strong working knowledge of California civil discovery procedures, workflows, and deadlines.

- Demonstrated experience preparing interrogatories, requests for production, requests for admission, and related discovery responses.

- Fluent English and Spanish, both written and spoken, with the confidence to communicate directly with Spanish-speaking clients about detailed case information.

- Strong legal drafting and document-review skills, including experience preparing pleadings and supporting litigation documents.

- Experience managing multiple active matters, competing deadlines, litigation calendars, and court filing requirements with a high degree of accuracy.

- Ability to independently handle routine civil litigation work, proactively resolve missing information, and appropriately escalate substantive legal questions to attorneys.

Nice to Have:

- Experience with California Superior Court electronic filing systems.

- Experience using MerusCase or comparable litigation case management software; MerusCase experience is strongly preferred.

- Paralegal certification or formal legal education.

- Previous experience working remotely with U.S. attorneys or litigation teams.

- Broader experience supporting motions and other pretrial litigation work.

scraped.title: Personal Assistant
scraped.description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
About the role
Our team acts as the engine that ensures our leaders use their time on the most highly-leveraged work.

 You’ll be responsible for the leadership team’s calendars, travel, and relationships and provide other operational, strategic, and project support as needed. You'll be incredibly close to the leaders helping to bring AI products to the world.

This role is based in Malaysia. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. Occasional travel may be needed for this unique role.
Your responsibilities would include

- Act as a confidante and strategic partner to our leadership staff by ensuring their time is spent on the most leveraged activities

- Make recommendations regarding time management, prioritization, and delegation

- Coordinate meetings and clear conflicts for our senior leadership team; ensure critical meetings aren’t missed or delayed and are prioritized accordingly

- Arrange flight, hotel, car, and restaurant reservations for members of this group, and perform other administrative tasks as needed

- Work with our recruiting team to coordinate interviews for technical/business leaders and collect their timely feedback

- Work on special projects on an as-needed basis

Experience we're seeking

- You have 5-7 years of experience in an executive support role or similar support function

- You've worked with technical or business leaders and supported multiple leaders in the past

- You’ve worked in a high-growth startup, investment banking, or similar environment

- You've managed and optimized extremely busy calendars

- You're fluent in Google Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Gmail, and other modern productivity software, and are excited to learn and use new tools

Our team & culture
We’re a lean, high-performance team that moves fast and holds a high bar. Titles don’t matter here - output, integrity, and ownership do. Everyone is expected to roll up their sleeves, contribute meaningfully, and take initiative.

We reward people who think like owners. We value speed, clarity, and relentless ownership. If you’re hungry to grow and care deeply about excellence, this is your kind of environment.

What will you get

- Competitive salary and trusted position supporting a high-level leader

- A dynamic, fast-moving environment where you’re valued for your reliability and ownership

- Occasional exposure to business-side support for broader growth and experience

Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Hong Kong. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Hong Kong.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process:
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Role-specific interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.
Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

scraped.title: Medical Records Clerk | Philippines
scraped.description:
- Job Type: Full-time, long-term contractor

- Workplace: Remote

- Schedule: Full-time, aligned with U.S. business hours (Pacific Time Zone)

- Compensation: $800 - $1,000 USD

About Us
HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful remote opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies. We focus on building high-performing distributed teams with clear expectations, strong support, and an outcomes-first approach to work. 
For this opportunity, you will support a high-volume U.S. personal injury law practice where accurate, timely medical documentation directly affects how quickly cases can move forward.
About the Role
As a Medical Records Clerk, you will own the process of requesting, tracking, and retrieving medical records and itemized bills from U.S. healthcare providers. You will step into a team managing a significant volume of outstanding documentation, so consistent provider follow-up and strong organization will be central to your success.
Your work will help prevent delays as cases move toward demand preparation and other key stages of the personal injury lifecycle. This is a strong fit for someone who already understands U.S. medical records retrieval, is comfortable spending a meaningful part of the day on outbound follow-up, and takes satisfaction in closing the loop on difficult or delayed requests.
The working schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time.
Responsibilities

- Own medical records and itemized billing requests from initial submission through successful retrieval.

- Prepare and submit accurate HIPAA-compliant records requests and authorizations to hospitals, physicians, clinics, and other U.S. healthcare providers.

- Conduct consistent outbound follow-up with medical offices and provider records departments to keep outstanding requests moving.

- Track every request, follow-up, response, and pending item accurately using internal systems and spreadsheets.

- Review received medical records and bills for completeness, accuracy, and relevance to the client's accident and treatment.

- Identify missing records, incomplete billing, discrepancies, or documentation gaps and coordinate corrections with providers.

- Ensure required medical documentation is available as personal injury matters progress toward the demand stage.

- Coordinate closely with records department leads, case managers, and other internal teams to resolve documentation issues.

- Manage a high volume of simultaneous requests while meeting productivity, turnaround, and quality expectations.

- Assist with claims-opening or related administrative processes when needed.

Requirements

Must-Have:

- Prior hands-on experience requesting and retrieving medical records and medical bills from U.S. healthcare providers.

- Experience supporting U.S. personal injury matters or working within a personal injury legal environment.

- Strong spoken and written English, including confidence communicating directly with U.S. hospitals, clinics, physicians, and records departments.

- Working knowledge of HIPAA authorizations and the U.S. medical records retrieval process.

- Proven ability to manage a high volume of open requests, follow-ups, and deadlines without losing accuracy.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and persistence in following requests through to completion.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, spreadsheets, and digital tracking systems.

Nice to Have:

- Experience supporting a California-based personal injury law firm.

- Familiarity with medical billing, liens, subrogation, insurance claims, and provider billing processes.

- Experience using medical records retrieval platforms such as ProScan.

- Experience with legal case management systems such as Filevine or CASEpeer.

- Familiarity with the personal injury case lifecycle, particularly treatment documentation and demand preparation.
