scraped.description:
About FreedUp

FreedUp places talented Executive Assistants with founders and executives at growing US companies. We free leaders up by saving them time and effort so they can focus on the work only they can do. For our EAs, we aim to be one of the best US companies for LATAM and Filipino talent, with a supportive environment and real room to grow.
About the role
We're looking for a sharp, proactive Executive Assistant to be the "second brain" for a fast-moving US entrepreneur. He runs a growing private aircraft sales business, where many leads come in through his social media content, and he co-owns a pool services company.
You'll own his CRM, keep his sales team on track, stay on top of his calendar, files and travel, and help with the personal details that make life run smoothly. You won't just follow instructions: he wants someone who audits how things are done, spots gaps without being told, and suggests what to hand off next. This is a behind-the-scenes role. He handles all client calls and onboarding himself.
Compensation: 1,000 to 1,700 USD (Depends on Experience)
Location: Remote, LATAM
Job Type: Full-time
What you'll do
1. Own the Notion CRM (ramps up gradually)

- Keep the aviation sales pipeline watertight: deal stages, last-contact dates and next steps always current.

- Add new and missing deals, including aircraft that go under contract, and flag stale records (for example, "last contact was months ago").

- After each recorded sales Zoom call, use the transcript and Claude to create the CRM entry with the contact's details, write next steps and delegate follow-ups to the right sales rep.

- Take over the CRM step by step as you learn the nuances of the business.

2. Coordinate the sales team

- Follow up with the two sales reps so they stay on top of their leads and keep their deals updated in the CRM, without adding extra admin work to their plate.

- Make sure every deal has clear next steps and that aircraft listings get the visibility they need.

- Send him consolidated status overviews so he can see the whole pipeline at a glance.

3. Manage Dropbox filing (from day one)

- Move aircraft photos, videos, spec sheets, sales brochures, maintenance status reports, contracts, LOIs, APAs and deposit confirmations from email into the right Dropbox folders as soon as they arrive.

- Follow a clear SOP and keep everything consistent as the team grows. Much of this material is sensitive or client-facing, so accuracy matters.

4. Manage his calendar and reminders

- Manage his Outlook calendar and his availability for calls booked through Calendly.

- Handle reschedule requests and send short scheduling emails to clients when needed.

- Send a proactive end-of-day "here's tomorrow" text with his meetings, addresses, links, documents or waivers to sign, and anything he needs to bring, plus a suggested time for his daily workout around a busy schedule.

5. Book travel

- Plan two to three mostly domestic trips a month, comparing options on Kayak and booking through airline apps.

- Follow his saved preferences: direct flights, no very early departures and exit row seats, with his traveler details on file.

- Handle booking, check-in and confirmations so everything is ready on his phone.

6. Handle personal and admin tasks

- Take care of waivers, vehicle registrations and other paperwork for his trucks and businesses.

- Remember birthdays and anniversaries, and arrange flowers and gifts for his wife and kids within a set budget.

scraped.title: Executive Support Specialist - California Insurance Experience Required
scraped.description:
The client moves fast. Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks — before anyone notices it almost did.
About RemotePro.ph
We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.
To apply, please visit us at: 
Summary
This role is focused on California insurance — personal and commercial lines. A big part of your day will be handling renewals, quotes, and account servicing. If you've worked inside a California insurance agency recently and know how personal and commercial lines operate — you'll feel right at home here. If you haven't, this role isn't the right fit.
Beyond the insurance work, you'll be supporting day-to-day operations — managing communication, keeping things organized, and making sure nothing gets missed. You'll be expected to use AI tools regularly to work faster and produce better outputs. Not occasionally. Daily.

The Mindset We’re Looking For
The best Executive Support Specialists we’ve worked with share a few traits:

- They’re the person their friends call when they need to figure something out. Not because they always have the answer — but because they know how to think through a problem, ask the right questions, and get to a solution 

- They don’t wait to be told. If they see something that needs to happen, they handle it — then let the client know it’s done, not ask if they should do it 

- They’re honest even when it costs them. If they make a mistake, they say so immediately. If something isn’t working, they raise it. They don’t manage perception — they manage reality 

- They’re genuinely curious. It’s not enough to be smart — they actively seek out new things to learn, ask questions other people don’t think to ask, and find most topics at least a little interesting 

- They treat confidentiality as non-negotiable. What happens in the client’s world stays there — no exceptions, no grey areas 

- They use AI the way a sharp operator would — not as a novelty, but as a tool that makes their output faster and better than anyone who isn’t using it

Who Thrives Here
People who are quietly excellent — not flashy, but consistently sharp, reliable, and ahead of the curve. You don’t need recognition for every task you handle. You find satisfaction in the fact that things run smoothly because of you, even if no one notices the work behind it.
We’re a growing MSP, which means priorities shift, new tasks appear, and not everything is perfectly documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a problem — it’s an environment where someone who takes initiative and uses every tool available naturally stands out.

This Role Is Not for You If:

- You need constant direction and check-ins to stay on track 

- You treat “that’s not my job” as a reasonable response 

- You let things slip and wait for someone else to notice 

- You’d stay quiet about a mistake to avoid a difficult conversation 

- Confidentiality feels like a guideline rather than a hard rule 

- You’re uncomfortable with shifting priorities and changing plans 

- You’ve never seriously used AI tools in your daily work and don’t intend to start 

- Learning new things feels like a chore rather than something you actually enjoy 

There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.
Responsibilities
You'll be managing a mix of insurance operations and administrative support in a fast-moving remote environment. Your job is to keep things running, stay ahead of deadlines, and make sure nothing gets dropped.
That looks like:

- Handling renewals, quotes, and account servicing for personal and commercial insurance lines — this is the core of the role

- Managing inbound communication across email and phone — triaging, responding where appropriate, and escalating only what genuinely needs attention

- Tracking open action items, follow-ups, and deadlines so nothing slips — and flagging anything at risk before it becomes a problem

- Managing calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination

- Preparing reports, summaries, and briefing materials that are clear and ready to use without further editing

- Maintaining organized records across CRM systems and shared drives — so information is always findable and current

- Using AI tools to draft communications, summarize threads, and eliminate repetitive manual tasks

- Supporting market research, competitor analysis, and social media scheduling when needed

Requirements

- At least 1 year of recent, hands-on experience working inside a California insurance agency — personal and commercial lines — handling renewals, quoting, and account servicing; this is the non-negotiable requirement for this role

- Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, easy to listen to; clients always feel heard

- Proven experience in a support, virtual assistant, or administrative role

- Active, confident daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent)

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace

- Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, or equivalent)

- Strong written English — emails are clear and professional before they're sent

- High attention to detail — errors get caught before they leave your desk

- Strong organizational skills — multiple priorities, nothing slips

- Self-directed once you're up to speed — asks the right questions early, works independently after

Nice to Have

- Experience with AI-powered workflow automation tools (Make, Zapier, n8n, or equivalent) 

- Experience supporting C-suite or senior leadership in a remote environment 

- Familiarity with project management tools (ClickUp, Asana, Trello, or Monday.com) 

- Basic bookkeeping or invoice processing experience (QuickBooks or Xero) 

- Experience with market research and competitor analysis

How We Work
We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it.
There’s real work to be done — clients depend on us — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.
We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the workflows, systems, and habits that make us better as we grow.
Benefits
Permanent Work-from-Home Setup
Competitive Salary
HMO Coverage
Mental Health Programs
Maternity Assistance through HMO (Female employees)
Paid Vacation Leave
Technology Allowance
Internet Allowance
Weekly Payouts
Career Growth and Advancement Opportunities

- 
Schedule: Monday-Friday schedule, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM PST. or 9:00 AM-6:00 PM PST

About Us
HireHawk connects experienced professionals with U.S. companies building high-performing remote teams. For this opportunity, you will support a U.S.-based legal practice handling Personal Injury civil litigation, working closely with attorneys while taking meaningful ownership of day-to-day litigation support.
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced bilingual English-Spanish Civil Litigation Paralegal with hands-on California Personal Injury litigation experience. You will take substantial ownership of written discovery, communicate directly with Spanish-speaking clients, prepare litigation documents, and help attorneys keep cases moving toward deadlines.
This is role is for someone who already understands how California civil litigation works in practice. You should be comfortable handling routine litigation matters independently, identifying what information is missing, following up proactively, and knowing when an issue requires attorney review.
The team values practical PI litigation knowledge, reliability, and work ethic more than having a minimal accent. Strong bilingual communication and the ability to get accurate information from clients matter most.
Responsibilities

- Own the preparation, organization, and coordination of written discovery for California Personal Injury litigation matters.

- Prepare and support responses to interrogatories, requests for production, requests for admission, and related discovery requests.

- Communicate directly with English- and Spanish-speaking clients to gather case facts, records, documents, and other information required for discovery.

- Review client responses and supporting documents, identify missing or incomplete information, and follow up until discovery packages are ready for attorney review.

- Draft and prepare pleadings and other routine civil litigation documents with limited supervision.

- Coordinate with attorneys to ensure discovery responses, pleadings, and supporting materials are complete, accurate, and submitted on time.

- Track California litigation deadlines, discovery due dates, court dates, and other case-related milestones.

- Prepare and coordinate California Superior Court filings and electronic filings.

- Organize medical records, supporting documents, client materials, and litigation files so attorneys can quickly access the information they need.

- Assist with motions and other litigation documentation when required while recognizing when attorney input or approval is necessary.

Requirements

Must-Have:

- Significant hands-on experience supporting U.S. Personal Injury civil litigation matters, including practical California litigation experience.

- Strong working knowledge of California civil discovery procedures, workflows, and deadlines.

- Demonstrated experience preparing interrogatories, requests for production, requests for admission, and related discovery responses.

- Fluent English and Spanish, both written and spoken, with the confidence to communicate directly with Spanish-speaking clients about detailed case information.

- Strong legal drafting and document-review skills, including experience preparing pleadings and supporting litigation documents.

- Experience managing multiple active matters, competing deadlines, litigation calendars, and court filing requirements with a high degree of accuracy.

- Ability to independently handle routine civil litigation work, proactively resolve missing information, and appropriately escalate substantive legal questions to attorneys.

Nice to Have:

- Experience with California Superior Court electronic filing systems.

- Experience using MerusCase or comparable litigation case management software; MerusCase experience is strongly preferred.

- Paralegal certification or formal legal education.

- Previous experience working remotely with U.S. attorneys or litigation teams.

- Broader experience supporting motions and other pretrial litigation work.

scraped.description:
Executive Assistant – Irth Solutions
Job Type: Full-Time 
Location: Columbus, Ohio (Preferred); Open to Eastern and Central Time Zones 
Department: G&A
Reports To: VP, Talent Success in support of the Chief Commercial Officer primarily and the C-Suite executive
Company Overview
Irth Solutions is a software product company developing innovative technology platforms designed to set industry benchmarks. With a strong product culture, collaborative work environment, and significant growth potential, Irth offers an exciting opportunity to work with modern, enterprise-scale data platforms.
Position Summary
Irth Solutions is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative support to the Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) and supplemental support to the CEO and other senior leaders.
Working closely with the existing Executive Assistant and broader administrative team, this individual will manage complex executive calendars, coordinate travel and events, track meeting agendas and action items, oversee day-to-day office operations, and develop scalable administrative processes.
The ideal candidate is detail-obsessed, able to multitask, self-directed, flexible across leadership priorities, comfortable in a fast-changing, growing organization, and trusted with confidential information. This role is well suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, growing organization and enjoys building efficient processes that support executive effectiveness.
This is a full-time position. While there is a preference for candidates within commuting distance of our headquarters in Columbus, Ohio, we are considering all Eastern and Central time zone candidates.
Key Responsibilities
1. Executive Support & Calendar Management

- Manage complex, high-volume calendars for the CCO and supplemental support for the rest of the C-Suite leaders, including but not limited to: scheduling and coordinating meetings, conferences, and calls with internal and external parties across time zones and functions.

- Anticipate and proactively resolve scheduling conflicts and adjustments to ensure optimal time management.

- Prepare meeting agendas and relevant documents for all appointments and events.

- Maintain and track executive agendas, ensuring all key meetings, deadlines, and deliverables are met.

- Provide reminders and follow up on action items from meetings and projects.

- Maintain files, records, and other documents for the executives, ensuring confidentiality and organization.

- Assist with presentations, reports, and other important documents as needed.

- Prioritize competing executive requests, exercising judgment on what should be moved, protected, delegated, or escalated.

- Flex across additional executives and shifting leadership priorities as the organization evolves.

2. Travel & Event Coordination

- Manage travel arrangements, accommodations, and itineraries, covering flights, lodging, ground transportation, and expense documentation.

- Coordinate logistics for internal and external events, including company meetings, conferences, webinars, and team-building activities.

- Ensure events run smoothly and efficiently, managing the setup, equipment, and supplies.

3. Process Improvement & Administrative Infrastructure

- Develop and maintain administrative processes and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

- Identify opportunities for greater efficiency and automation, including through AI tools.

- Create repeatable executive-support practices that can be shared across the team.

- Help establish scalable administrative infrastructure as Irth grows.

4. Office Operations & Employee Experience

- Oversee daily office operations, including office supplies, equipment maintenance, and vendor management.

- Maintain a clean, organized, and productive office environment.

- Manage incoming and outgoing mail and packages, ensuring timely and accurate delivery.

- Coordinate logistics for office supplies, equipment, and materials.

What Success Looks Like
The successful candidate will:

- Ensure the CCO's calendar and schedule are organized, accurate, and aligned with business priorities.

- Provide reliable, proactive administrative support with minimal oversight.

- Help the CCO stay focused by anticipating needs and managing follow-through.

- Establish strong working relationships with the existing Executive Assistant and administrative team.

- Improve administrative workflows through documentation, consistency, and thoughtful use of technology.

- Ensure travel, meetings, events, and office operations are handled efficiently.

- Contribute to a scalable administrative support structure as Irth continues to grow.

Requirements
Required Qualifications

- Minimum of 5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant supporting C-Suite executives.

- Exceptional attention to detail, organizational and time-management skills.

- 3-5 years experience using Microsoft products (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint) required.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information.

- Ability to use AI tools such as Copilot or Claude.

- Ability to work on-site in Columbus, OH on a hybrid schedule; or if hired as remote employee, travel as needed to support executive team (less than 15% of the year)

- Proven ability to manage complex, high-volume calendars and prioritize competing executive requests.

- Flexibility to support additional executives and shifting leadership priorities.

- Comfort operating in a fast-changing, growing organization.

AI Use in Hiring
As part of our hiring process, Irth may use artificial intelligence (AI) or automated tools to assist with reviewing and screening applications. These tools are intended to support the hiring process but do not replace human judgment or decision-making. All hiring decisions involve human review.
Role Type
This is a New Position. 
Compensation
The salary range for this role is USD $65,000-75,000. This range reflects the base salary only and does not include any other compensation components like OTE. Any offers made are dependent on factors including and not limited to experience, skills, and location.
Benefits
Why Join Irth?
At Irth, we believe great work happens when people have the support, flexibility, and resources they need to do their best work. As part of the Irth team, you'll enjoy:

- Competitive compensation commensurate with experience.

- The opportunity to join a dynamic, growing company that is well respected within its industry.

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance options.

- A 401(k) plan with company match.

- Flexible PTO policy and company-paid holidays.

- Additional benefits, including life insurance, pet insurance, employee discounts, and perks programs.

- A generous one-time work-from-home stipend to help you create a productive and comfortable remote workspace.

- Opportunities to connect with colleagues through monthly company lunches, volunteer outings, and quarterly team gatherings.

- Complimentary snacks, beverages, and coffee for employees visiting our Columbus, Ohio office.

At Irth, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution, collaborate with a talented team, and grow alongside an evolving technology company.

scraped.title: AI Testing Assistant
scraped.description:
Mosaic Conseil operates as a small, remote workshop dedicated to rebuilding one business artifact at a time. Whether it is a three year plan, a pricing grid, or a diligence file, we take things apart on the bench and put them back together against the evidence of the invoice ledger. The process is personal and focused. We do not work on standing retainers and we do not produce slide decks. Instead, we return the same artifact you sent, redrawn by hand and supported by a written argument. Our work is handled on paper and backed by a telephone number that answers for ninety days. We keep the workshop small on purpose to ensure that the people who do the work also answer their own phones. There are no meetings we did not schedule and no corporate theater. We focus on four specific rooms: financial services, industrial networks, growing software companies, and healthcare systems.
 
About Mosaic Conseil
 We are a boutique consultancy that values intellectual honesty and the discipline of a small, focused team. By staying small and fully remote, we remain independent and focused on the evidence at the floor of the business. Our clients come to us when they need a business plan or a financial model rebuilt with extreme precision. We provide a workspace where the primary goal is getting the numbers and the logic right, rather than making things look good in a presentation. Every file that leaves our workshop carries two names on the cover: one person who builds and one who argues against what was built. This ensures that every assumption is tested before a file closes. This environment is built for thinkers who prefer a written argument over a status meeting.
 
What you would do
 As an AI Testing Assistant, your work focuses on the intersection of business logic and automated analysis. You will be responsible for testing the outputs of AI models used to process financial and industrial data. This is an entry level role where you support our consultants by stress testing the artifacts we build. Your day to day work involves: 
- Reviewing AI generated summaries and data extractions for accuracy against original source documents like ledgers or contracts.
 
- Running standardized tests on internal AI tools to identify where they fail to grasp complex financial logic or industrial constraints.
 
- Building simple test cases to verify that a pricing model or a business plan remains consistent when variables are changed.
 
- Documenting specific instances of model error or hallucination in a clear, written format.
 
- Assisting the challenger in our builder and challenger model by providing evidence of where an automated calculation may have deviated from the truth.
 
- Comparing different AI model outputs to see which one handles specific industry terminology from healthcare or industrial networks more reliably.
 
- Verifying that the data used for a specific business artifact has been correctly mapped by our automated scripts.

Helpful background
 We are looking for individuals who have a natural curiosity about how technology works and, more importantly, how it breaks. This role is accessible to those starting their career or looking for part time work while finishing their studies. Helpful traits and experiences include: 
- Basic familiarity with Large Language Models and an understanding of how to prompt them for technical tasks.
 
- Competence in using spreadsheets like Excel or Google Sheets to verify calculations.
 
- Strong writing skills and the ability to explain a technical error in plain English.
 
- A background in business, finance, or computer science is useful but we value the ability to follow a logical argument above a specific degree.

About the Role

We’re looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support a US-based commercial real estate brokerage team with marketing, research, listing management, and day-to-day administrative tasks.

This role is ideal for someone who goes beyond basic AI prompting and understands how to use tools like ChatGPT and other AI platforms to get things done more efficiently. You'll be expected to use AI to research information, organize data, create and refine content, simplify repetitive tasks, and identify opportunities to improve existing workflows.

You'll also support marketing activities, online property listings, document preparation, and general administrative tasks. While marketing experience is valuable, we're particularly interested in candidates who are comfortable experimenting with AI tools, figuring out how to solve unfamiliar problems, and turning ideas into practical solutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Marketing & Content Support

- 
Create and update marketing materials, presentations, brochures, flyers, and promotional content using existing templates and digital tools.

- 
Use AI tools to assist with drafting property descriptions, marketing copy, email campaigns, research summaries, and other content.

- 
Review and edit AI-generated content to ensure accuracy, clarity, consistency, and a professional tone before sharing or publishing.

- 
Coordinate property images, maps, aerial imagery, and other visual assets for marketing materials.

- 
Assist with email marketing campaigns, property announcements, and promotional activities.

- 
Help coordinate the preparation and updating of property signage.

2. AI & Digital Tools

- 
Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and other relevant platforms to streamline research, drafting, data organization, and repetitive administrative work.

- 
Develop effective prompts and workflows to generate useful, accurate outputs for day-to-day tasks.

- 
Verify AI-generated information against reliable sources rather than relying on unverified outputs.

- 
Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve efficiency, reduce manual work, and support team productivity.

- 
Learn and adapt to new software, platforms, and workflows as business needs evolve.

3. Research & Data Management

- 
Conduct online research to gather property details, market information, comparable listings, and other relevant data.

- 
Maintain and update internal databases, spreadsheets, contact lists, and property records.

- 
Collect, organize, and verify information from multiple sources.

- 
Ensure data is accurate, complete, and consistently formatted.

- 
Identify missing information, inconsistencies, or errors and follow up as needed.

4. Listing & Administrative Support

- 
Create and update online listings using approved information, templates, and workflows.

- 
Maintain accurate property details, descriptions, pricing, images, and supporting documents across relevant platforms.

- 
Prepare and organize documents using established templates.

- 
Assist with sending documents through DocuSign and tracking signatures or outstanding paperwork.

- 
Support the preparation of listing agreements and other brokerage documents using approved templates and instructions.

- 
Keep marketing assets, property records, and administrative documents organized and easy to access.

- 
Track pending tasks, follow up on outstanding items, and provide general support to the brokerage team.

Requirements

- 
Experience in virtual assistance, administrative support, marketing coordination, research, data management, or a similar role.

- 
Strong experience in AI tools such as ChatGPT to support research, writing, content creation, and administrative workflows.

- 
Strong attention to detail and the ability to verify information before using or sharing it.

- 
Good written English and the ability to produce clear, professional content.

- 
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines independently.

- 
Comfortable working with spreadsheets, online databases, document management tools, and web-based platforms.

- 
Resourceful and quick to learn new software and processes.

- 
Able to work independently in a remote environment and communicate proactively with a US-based team.

Nice to Have

- 
Experience with commercial real estate, property management, or real estate marketing.

- 
Familiarity with platforms such as Buildout, CoStar, LoopNet, or Crexi.

- 
Experience with Canva or similar tools for creating marketing materials.

- 
Familiarity with DocuSign, email marketing platforms, and CRM systems.

- 
Experience using AI tools beyond basic prompting, including building repeatable workflows or using AI to improve productivity.

- 
Experience coordinating property imagery, maps, aerial photos, or signage.

What We're Looking For

- 
AI-savvy: Comfortable using AI to improve the speed and quality of everyday work, while checking outputs carefully.

- 
Detail-oriented: Takes the time to verify facts, review documents, and catch inconsistencies.

- 
Proactive: Spots what needs to be done and follows through without constant supervision.

- 
Adaptable: Learns new platforms and workflows quickly, even without prior industry experience.

- 
Organized: Keeps information, files, and tasks structured and easy to track.

- 
Resourceful: Knows how to research unfamiliar topics, find reliable information, and solve problems independently.

The ideal candidate combines strong administrative and marketing skills with practical AI experience and a willingness to learn.
